CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION ops.read_pdf_published_revision(p_task bigint, p_key text, p_digest text)
 RETURNS SETOF ops.pdf_published_revision
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
BEGIN ATOMIC
 SELECT pdf_published_revision.build_id,
     pdf_published_revision.task_id,
     pdf_published_revision.product_key,
     pdf_published_revision.logical_digest,
     pdf_published_revision.release_id,
     pdf_published_revision.source_digest,
     pdf_published_revision.schema_digest,
     pdf_published_revision.recipe_digest,
     pdf_published_revision.frozen_digest,
     pdf_published_revision.kind
    FROM (ops.pdf_published_revision
      JOIN ops.pdf_stage_build ON ((pdf_published_revision.build_id = pdf_stage_build.build_id)))
   WHERE ((pdf_published_revision.task_id = read_pdf_published_revision.p_task) AND (pdf_published_revision.product_key = read_pdf_published_revision.p_key) AND (pdf_published_revision.logical_digest = read_pdf_published_revision.p_digest) AND (pdf_stage_build.state = 'published'::text));
END

SELECT native_document_product.task_id,
    native_document_product.product_key,
    native_document_product.content_digest,
    native_document_product.release_id,
    native_document_product.contract_digest,
    native_document_product.schema_digest,
    native_document_product.recipe_digest,
    native_document_product.parent_task_id,
    native_document_product.parent_product_key,
    native_document_product.parent_digest,
    native_document_product.native_json,
    native_document_product.health,
    native_document_product.payload
   FROM ops.native_document_product
UNION ALL
 SELECT p.task_id,
    p.product_key,
    p.content_digest,
    p.release_id,
    p.contract_digest,
    (body.descriptor -> 'content_metadata'::text) ->> 'schema_digest'::text AS schema_digest,
    (body.descriptor -> 'content_metadata'::text) ->> 'recipe_digest'::text AS recipe_digest,
    NULL::bigint AS parent_task_id,
    NULL::text AS parent_product_key,
    NULL::text AS parent_digest,
    b.content -> 'document'::text AS native_json,
    (body.descriptor -> 'content_metadata'::text) -> 'health'::text AS health,
    body.payload
   FROM ops.pdf_product p
     JOIN ops.pdf_product_body body USING (task_id, product_key)
     CROSS JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT (convert_from(body.payload, 'UTF8'::name)::json -> 'content'::text)::jsonb AS content) b
  WHERE p.kind = 'integrated'::text
UNION ALL
 SELECT p.task_id,
    p.product_key,
    p.logical_digest AS content_digest,
    p.release_id,
    contract_input.content_digest AS contract_digest,
    p.schema_digest,
    p.recipe_digest,
    NULL::bigint AS parent_task_id,
    NULL::text AS parent_product_key,
    NULL::text AS parent_digest,
    NULL::jsonb AS native_json,
    ( SELECT c.body - ARRAY['source_scope'::text, 'page_start'::text, 'page_end'::text]
           FROM kb.pdf_record_companion c
          WHERE c.product_id = p.build_id AND c.revision_id = p.build_id AND c.family = 'health'::text AND c.body ? 'source_scope'::text
          ORDER BY c.ordinal, c.local_id
         LIMIT 1) AS health,
    NULL::bytea AS payload
   FROM ops.pdf_published_revision p
     JOIN ops.pdf_build_validation v ON v.build_id = p.build_id
     JOIN sem.input contract_input ON contract_input.release_id = p.release_id AND contract_input.input_kind = 'dependency'::text AND contract_input.input_name = 'execution/schema/pdf_products'::text;

 CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT (convert_from(body.payload,'UTF8')::json->'content')::jsonb content) b WHERE p.kind='integrated'

WITH RECURSIVE published AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT * FROM ops.read_pdf_published_revision(p_task,p_key,p_digest)
 ), access AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT a.* FROM kb.pdf_record_access a JOIN published p
  ON a.product_id=p.build_id AND a.revision_id=p.build_id
 ), scope_pointers(pointer) AS (
  SELECT unnest(p_pointers) UNION SELECT p_section
  UNION SELECT a.parent_pointer FROM access a JOIN scope_pointers s ON a.pointer=s.pointer
  WHERE a.parent_pointer IS NOT NULL
 ), selected AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT c.* FROM kb.pdf_record_companion c JOIN published p ON c.product_id=p.build_id AND c.revision_id=p.build_id
  WHERE c.family='occurrence' AND c.body->>'pointer'=ANY(p_pointers)
 ), related AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT e.relation_id FROM kb.pdf_record_endpoint e JOIN published p ON e.product_id=p.build_id AND e.revision_id=p.build_id
  JOIN selected c ON c.local_id=e.occurrence_id
  WHERE (e.target_task_id=p_task AND e.target_product_key=p_key AND e.target_content_digest=p_digest)
   OR (e.target_task_id=0 AND e.target_product_key='@self' AND e.target_content_digest='@self')
 ), endpoints AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT e.* FROM kb.pdf_record_endpoint e JOIN published p ON e.product_id=p.build_id AND e.revision_id=p.build_id
  JOIN related r USING(relation_id)
 ), pages AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT (o.body->>'page_no')::bigint AS page_no FROM selected o
  WHERE o.body->>'page_no' ~ '^[0-9]+$'
  UNION
  SELECT DISTINCT (prov->>'page_no')::bigint FROM access a
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(a.native_json->'prov','[]')) prov
  WHERE a.pointer=ANY(p_pointers) AND prov->>'page_no' ~ '^[0-9]+$'
 ), covered AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT c.* FROM kb.pdf_record_companion c JOIN published p ON c.product_id=p.build_id AND c.revision_id=p.build_id
  WHERE c.family='coverage' AND (c.body->>'scope'='whole_document'
   OR c.body->>'scope' IN (SELECT pointer||':'||membership FROM scope_pointers
    CROSS JOIN (VALUES('direct'),('descendants')) m(membership))
   OR c.body->>'scope' IN (SELECT 'page:'||page_no::text FROM pages)
   OR CASE WHEN c.body->>'scope' ~ '^pages:[0-9]+-[0-9]+$' THEN EXISTS(
    SELECT FROM pages WHERE page_no BETWEEN
     split_part(split_part(c.body->>'scope',':',2),'-',1)::bigint AND
     split_part(split_part(c.body->>'scope',':',2),'-',2)::bigint) ELSE false END)
 ), inputs AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT c.* FROM kb.pdf_record_companion c JOIN published p ON c.product_id=p.build_id AND c.revision_id=p.build_id
  WHERE c.family='input' AND (EXISTS(SELECT FROM endpoints e WHERE e.role<>'output' AND
   (e.target_task_id,e.target_product_key,e.target_content_digest)=
   ((c.body->>'task_id')::bigint,c.body->>'product_key',c.body->>'content_digest')) OR
   c.local_id IN (SELECT support->>'input_index' FROM covered x
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(x.body->'supports','[]')) support))
 ), chosen AS (
  SELECT * FROM selected UNION ALL SELECT * FROM covered UNION ALL SELECT * FROM inputs
  UNION ALL SELECT c.* FROM kb.pdf_record_companion c JOIN published p ON c.product_id=p.build_id AND c.revision_id=p.build_id
   WHERE c.family='relation' AND c.local_id IN (SELECT relation_id FROM related)
  UNION ALL SELECT c.* FROM kb.pdf_record_companion c JOIN published p ON c.product_id=p.build_id AND c.revision_id=p.build_id
   WHERE c.family='mapping_report' AND c.body->>'input_index' IN (SELECT local_id FROM inputs)
 ) SELECT c.family,c.local_id,c.ordinal,ops.pdf_companion_body(c.product_id,c.revision_id,c.family,c.local_id,c.body) FROM chosen c
catalog.result: TABLE(family text, local_id text, ordinal bigint, body jsonb)

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION ops.read_published_input_batch_rows(p_project text, p_run bigint, p_selection_release text, p_task bigint, p_product text, p_digest text, p_build text, p_producer_release text)
 RETURNS TABLE(input_ordinal bigint, input_role text, input_task_id bigint, input_product_key text, input_content_digest text, project_id text, run_id bigint, selection_release_id text, producer_release_id text, task_id bigint, product_key text, content_digest text, projection_id text)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
BEGIN ATOMIC
 WITH companions AS MATERIALIZED (
          SELECT raw.product_id,
             raw.revision_id,
             raw.family,
             raw.local_id,
             raw.ordinal,
             ops.pdf_companion_body(raw.product_id, raw.revision_id, raw.family, raw.local_id, raw.body) AS body
            FROM kb.pdf_record_companion raw
           WHERE ((raw.product_id = read_published_input_batch_rows.p_build) AND (raw.revision_id = read_published_input_batch_rows.p_build) AND (raw.family = 'input'::text))
         )
  SELECT c.ordinal AS input_ordinal,
     (c.body ->> 'role'::text) AS input_role,
     ((c.body ->> 'task_id'::text))::bigint AS input_task_id,
     (c.body ->> 'product_key'::text) AS input_product_key,
     (c.body ->> 'content_digest'::text) AS input_content_digest,
     read_published_input_batch_rows.p_project AS project_id,
     read_published_input_batch_rows.p_run AS run_id,
     read_published_input_batch_rows.p_selection_release AS selection_release_id,
     read_published_input_batch_rows.p_producer_release AS producer_release_id,
     read_published_input_batch_rows.p_task AS task_id,
     read_published_input_batch_rows.p_product AS product_key,
     read_published_input_batch_rows.p_digest AS content_digest,
     'pdf-companion-projection-v2:eb6b06280a7834337e9ef69c7db7f7cd9ba30a83547f3c9f79031a56eeb829c8'::text AS projection_id
    FROM companions c
   WHERE (c.family = 'input'::text)
   ORDER BY c.ordinal;
END
catalog.result: TABLE(input_ordinal bigint, input_role text, input_task_id bigint, input_product_key text, input_content_digest text, project_id text, run_id bigint, selection_release_id text, producer_release_id text, task_id bigint, product_key text, content_digest text, projection_id text)

DECLARE published ops.pdf_published_revision;
BEGIN
 published:=ops.require_published_companion_pin(p_project,p_run,p_selection_release,p_task,p_product,p_digest);
 RETURN QUERY WITH companions AS MATERIALIZED 
(SELECT CAST(raw.product_id AS TEXT) AS product_id, CAST(raw.revision_id AS TEXT) AS revision_id, CAST(raw.family AS TEXT) AS family, CAST(raw.local_id AS TEXT) AS local_id, CAST(raw.ordinal AS BIGINT) AS ordinal, CAST(ops.pdf_companion_body(raw.product_id, raw.revision_id, raw.family, raw.local_id, raw.body) AS JSONB) AS body 
FROM kb.pdf_record_companion AS raw

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION ops.read_pdf_published_sections_rows(p_build text, p_revision text)
 RETURNS TABLE(pointer text, parent_pointer text, ordinal bigint, label text, content_layer text, name text, ancestors text[], section_pointer text, text text)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
BEGIN ATOMIC
 WITH RECURSIVE access AS (
          SELECT pdf_record_access.product_id,
             pdf_record_access.revision_id,
             pdf_record_access.pointer,
             pdf_record_access.ordinal,
             pdf_record_access.label,
             pdf_record_access.parent_pointer,
             pdf_record_access.section_pointer,
             pdf_record_access.content_layer,
             pdf_record_access.text,
             pdf_record_access.native_json
            FROM kb.pdf_record_access
           WHERE ((pdf_record_access.product_id = read_pdf_published_sections_rows.p_build) AND (pdf_record_access.revision_id = read_pdf_published_sections_rows.p_revision))
         ), section_ancestors(section_pointer, ancestor, depth) AS (
          SELECT access_1.pointer AS section_pointer,
             access_1.parent_pointer AS ancestor,
             0 AS depth
            FROM access access_1
           WHERE ((access_1.label = ANY (ARRAY['section'::text, 'chapter'::text])) AND (access_1.parent_pointer IS NOT NULL))
         UNION ALL
          SELECT section_ancestors.section_pointer,
             parent_node.parent_pointer,
             (section_ancestors.depth + 1) AS anon_1
            FROM (section_ancestors
              JOIN access parent_node ON ((parent_node.pointer = section_ancestors.ancestor)))
           WHERE (parent_node.parent_pointer IS NOT NULL)
         )
  SELECT access.pointer,
     access.parent_pointer,
     access.ordinal,
     access.label,
     access.content_layer,
     (access.native_json ->> 'name'::text) AS name,
     COALESCE(( SELECT array_agg(section_ancestors.ancestor ORDER BY section_ancestors.depth DESC) AS array_agg_1
            FROM section_ancestors
           WHERE (section_ancestors.section_pointer = access.pointer)), ARRAY[]::text[]) AS ancestors,
     access.section_pointer,
     access.text
    FROM access
   WHERE (access.label = ANY (ARRAY['section'::text, 'chapter'::text]))
   ORDER BY access.ordinal;
END
catalog.result: TABLE(pointer text, parent_pointer text, ordinal bigint, label text, content_layer text, name text, ancestors text[], section_pointer text, text text)

 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
BEGIN ATOMIC
 WITH RECURSIVE access AS (
          SELECT pdf_record_access.product_id,
             pdf_record_access.revision_id,
             pdf_record_access.pointer,
             pdf_record_access.ordinal,
             pdf_record_access.label,
             pdf_record_access.parent_pointer,
             pdf_record_access.section_pointer,
             pdf_record_access.content_layer,
             pdf_record_access.text,
             pdf_record_access.native_json
            FROM kb.pdf_record_access
           WHERE ((pdf_record_access.product_id = read_pdf_published_section_nodes_rows.p_build) AND (pdf_record_access.revision_id = read_pdf_published_section_nodes_rows.p_revision))
         ), members(pointer) AS (
          SELECT access_1.pointer
            FROM access access_1
           WHERE ((access_1.pointer = read_pdf_published_section_nodes_rows.p_section) AND (access_1.content_layer = 'body'::text))
         UNION ALL
          SELECT child.pointer
            FROM (access child
              JOIN members ON ((child.parent_pointer = members.pointer)))
           WHERE ((child.content_layer = 'body'::text) AND ((read_pdf_published_section_nodes_rows.p_membership = 'descendants'::text) OR (child.label <> ALL (ARRAY['section'::text, 'chapter'::text]))))
         ), ancestors(pointer) AS (

           WHERE ((access_1.pointer = read_pdf_published_section_nodes_rows.p_section) AND (access_1.parent_pointer IS NOT NULL))
         UNION ALL
          SELECT parent.parent_pointer
            FROM (access parent
              JOIN ancestors ON ((parent.pointer = ancestors.pointer)))
           WHERE (parent.parent_pointer IS NOT NULL)
         )
  SELECT access.product_id,
     access.revision_id,
     access.pointer,
     access.ordinal,

 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
BEGIN ATOMIC
 WITH RECURSIVE access AS (
          SELECT pdf_record_access.product_id,
             pdf_record_access.revision_id,
             pdf_record_access.pointer,
             pdf_record_access.ordinal,
             pdf_record_access.label,
             pdf_record_access.parent_pointer,
             pdf_record_access.section_pointer,
             pdf_record_access.content_layer,
             pdf_record_access.text,
             pdf_record_access.native_json
            FROM kb.pdf_record_access
           WHERE ((pdf_record_access.product_id = read_pdf_published_item_page_rows.p_build) AND (pdf_record_access.revision_id = read_pdf_published_item_page_rows.p_revision))
         ), page_scope(pointer) AS (
          SELECT access_1.pointer
            FROM access access_1
           WHERE (access_1.pointer = read_pdf_published_item_page_rows.p_section)
         UNION ALL
          SELECT page_child.pointer
            FROM (access page_child
              JOIN page_scope ON ((page_child.parent_pointer = page_scope.pointer)))
         )
  SELECT access.product_id,
     access.revision_id,
     access.pointer,
     access.ordinal,
     access.label,
     access.parent_pointer,
     access.section_pointer,
     access.content_layer,
     access.text
    FROM access
   WHERE (((read_pdf_published_item_page_rows.p_section IS NULL) OR ((read_pdf_published_item_page_rows.p_membership = 'direct'::text) AND (access.section_pointer = read_pdf_published_item_page_rows.p_section)) OR ((read_pdf_published_item_page_rows.p_membership = 'descendants'::text) AND (access.pointer IN ( SELECT page_scope.pointer
            FROM page_scope)))) AND ((read_pdf_published_item_page_rows.p_pointer IS NULL) OR (access.pointer = read_pdf_published_item_page_rows.p_pointer)) AND (access.ordinal > read_pdf_published_item_page_rows.p_after))
   ORDER BY access.ordinal
  LIMIT read_pdf_published_item_page_rows.p_limit;
END

 RETURNS TABLE(product_id text, revision_id text, pointer text, ordinal bigint, label text, parent_pointer text, section_pointer text, content_layer text, text text)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
BEGIN ATOMIC
 WITH RECURSIVE access AS (
          SELECT pdf_record_access.product_id,
             pdf_record_access.revision_id,
             pdf_record_access.pointer,
             pdf_record_access.ordinal,
             pdf_record_access.label,
             pdf_record_access.parent_pointer,
             pdf_record_access.section_pointer,

            FROM kb.pdf_record_access
           WHERE ((pdf_record_access.product_id = read_pdf_published_item_ancestors_rows.p_build) AND (pdf_record_access.revision_id = read_pdf_published_item_ancestors_rows.p_revision))
         ), item_ancestry(pointer, parent_pointer) AS (
          SELECT access_1.pointer,
             access_1.parent_pointer
            FROM access access_1
           WHERE (access_1.pointer = read_pdf_published_item_ancestors_rows.p_pointer)
         UNION
          SELECT item_parent.pointer,
             item_parent.parent_pointer
            FROM (access item_parent
              JOIN item_ancestry ON ((item_parent.pointer = item_ancestry.parent_pointer)))
         )
  SELECT access.product_id,
     access.revision_id,
     access.pointer,
     access.ordinal,
     access.label,
     access.parent_pointer,
     access.section_pointer,
     access.content_layer,
     access.text
    FROM access
   WHERE (access.pointer IN ( SELECT item_ancestry.pointer
            FROM item_ancestry))
   ORDER BY access.ordinal;

 RETURNS TABLE(local_id text, ordinal bigint, body jsonb)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'

 WITH RECURSIVE diagnostic_reports AS MATERIALIZED (
          SELECT pdf_record_companion.local_id,
             pdf_record_companion.ordinal,
             ops.pdf_companion_body(pdf_record_companion.product_id, pdf_record_companion.revision_id, pdf_record_companion.family, pdf_record_companion.local_id, pdf_record_companion.body) AS body
            FROM kb.pdf_record_companion
           WHERE ((pdf_record_companion.product_id = read_pdf_published_item_reports_rows.p_build) AND (pdf_record_companion.revision_id = read_pdf_published_item_reports_rows.p_revision) AND (pdf_record_companion.family = 'native_metadata'::text) AND (cardinality(read_pdf_published_item_reports_rows.p_pointers) > 0) AND (((pdf_record_companion.body ->> 'kind'::text) = 'inline_alignment_reports'::text) OR (((pdf_record_companion.body ->> 'kind'::text) = ANY (ARRAY['cell_reports'::text, 'derivation_mappings'::text])) AND ((pdf_record_companion.body ->> 'pointer'::text) = ANY (read_pdf_published_item_reports_rows.p_pointers)))))
         ), access AS (
          SELECT pdf_record_access.product_id,
             pdf_record_access.revision_id,
             pdf_record_access.pointer,
             pdf_record_access.ordinal,
             pdf_record_access.label,
             pdf_record_access.parent_pointer,
             pdf_record_access.section_pointer,
             pdf_record_access.content_layer,
             pdf_record_access.text,
             pdf_record_access.native_json
            FROM kb.pdf_record_access
           WHERE ((pdf_record_access.product_id = read_pdf_published_item_reports_rows.p_build) AND (pdf_record_access.revision_id = read_pdf_published_item_reports_rows.p_revision))
         ), report_ancestry(pointer, parent_pointer) AS (
          SELECT access.pointer,
             access.parent_pointer
            FROM access
           WHERE (access.pointer = ANY (read_pdf_published_item_reports_rows.p_pointers))
         UNION
          SELECT report_parent.pointer,
             report_parent.parent_pointer
            FROM (access report_parent
              JOIN report_ancestry ON ((report_parent.pointer = report_ancestry.parent_pointer)))
         )
  SELECT diagnostic_reports.local_id,
     diagnostic_reports.ordinal,
     diagnostic_reports.body
    FROM diagnostic_reports
   WHERE (((diagnostic_reports.body ->> 'kind'::text) <> 'inline_alignment_reports'::text) OR (diagnostic_reports.body['value'::text]['item_pointers'::text] ?| ( SELECT COALESCE(array_agg(report_ancestry.pointer), ARRAY[]::text[]) AS coalesce_1
            FROM report_ancestry)))
   ORDER BY diagnostic_reports.ordinal, (diagnostic_reports.local_id COLLATE "C");
END

catalog.arguments: p_build text, p_task bigint, p_attempt bigint, p_holder text, p_frozen text
catalog.body:
DECLARE b ops.pdf_stage_build; logical_ text; contract_ text;
 prior_validation ops.pdf_build_validation; bad_owner_ boolean; unreachable_ boolean;
BEGIN
 PERFORM 1 FROM ops.pdf_stage_build WHERE build_id=p_build FOR NO KEY UPDATE;
 b:=ops.require_pdf_frozen(p_build,p_task,p_attempt,p_holder,p_frozen);
 PERFORM sem.require_execution_operation(b.release_id,'validate_pdf_build');
 SELECT * INTO prior_validation FROM ops.lookup_pdf_validation(
 p_build,p_task,p_attempt,p_holder,p_frozen);
 IF FOUND THEN RETURN NEXT prior_validation; RETURN; END IF;
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM ops.pdf_native_validation v WHERE v.build_id=p_build AND
 v.frozen_digest=p_frozen AND v.contract_digest=ops.pdf_validation_contract(b.release_id)
 AND v.passed) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'native callback conformance outcome missing or stale'
 USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM kb.pdf_record_native n WHERE n.product_id=p_build AND
 n.revision_id=p_build AND
 ops.pdf_native_record_shape(n.native_type,n.scalars_json,n.structure_json->'fields') IS NOT
 TRUE) THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'native schema field/required/primitive constraint differs' USING
 ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM kb.pdf_record_native n WHERE n.product_id=p_build AND
 n.revision_id=p_build AND
 (jsonb_typeof(n.structure_json->'fields') IS DISTINCT FROM 'object' OR
 EXISTS(SELECT FROM jsonb_each(n.structure_json->'fields') f WHERE f.value->>'kind' NOT IN
 ('object','array','map','parts')) OR
 EXISTS(SELECT FROM jsonb_object_keys(n.scalars_json) k WHERE n.structure_json->'fields' ?
 k))) THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid native field decomposition' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM kb.pdf_record_membership m LEFT JOIN kb.pdf_record_native n ON
 n.product_id=p_build AND n.revision_id=p_build AND n.record_id=m.parent_id
 WHERE m.product_id=p_build AND m.revision_id=p_build AND (n.record_id IS NULL OR
 n.structure_json->'fields'->m.field_name->>'kind' NOT IN ('array','map'))) THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'membership outside declared collection' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM kb.pdf_record_native n WHERE n.product_id=p_build AND
 n.revision_id=p_build AND n.scalars_json ? 'self_ref'
 GROUP BY n.scalars_json->>'self_ref' HAVING count(*)<>1) THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'native self-reference is not unique' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM kb.pdf_record_native n LEFT JOIN kb.pdf_record_reference r ON
 r.product_id=p_build AND r.revision_id=p_build AND r.source_id=n.record_id AND
 r.field_name='$ref'
 WHERE n.product_id=p_build AND n.revision_id=p_build AND n.native_type IN
 ('RefItem','FineRef') AND
 (r.reference_id IS NULL OR NOT
 ops.pdf_reference_bytes_equal(p_build,p_build,r.native_pointer,r.native_pointer_stream_id,
 n.scalars_json->>'$ref',n.structure_json->'fields'->'$ref'->>'stream_id'))) THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'native reference index does not correspond to supplied spelling' USING
 ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 WITH RECURSIVE owner_edges AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT n.record_id parent_id,f.value->>'target' child_id FROM kb.pdf_record_native n
 CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each(n.structure_json->'fields') f
 WHERE n.product_id=p_build AND n.revision_id=p_build AND f.value->>'kind'='object'
 UNION ALL SELECT parent_id,record_id FROM kb.pdf_record_membership
 WHERE product_id=p_build AND revision_id=p_build AND value_kind='record'
 ), owner_counts AS (
 SELECT child_id,count(parent_id) owners FROM owner_edges GROUP BY child_id
 ), reachable(record_id) AS (
 SELECT root_id FROM ops.pdf_record_document
 WHERE product_id=p_build AND revision_id=p_build
 UNION SELECT e.child_id FROM reachable r JOIN owner_edges e ON e.parent_id=r.record_id
 ) SELECT COALESCE(bool_or(COALESCE(owners.owners,0)<>CASE WHEN n.record_id=(
 SELECT root_id FROM ops.pdf_record_document
 WHERE product_id=p_build AND revision_id=p_build) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END),true),
 COALESCE(bool_or(reachable.record_id IS NULL),true) INTO bad_owner_,unreachable_
 FROM kb.pdf_record_native n LEFT JOIN owner_counts owners ON owners.child_id=n.record_id
 LEFT JOIN reachable ON reachable.record_id=n.record_id
 WHERE n.product_id=p_build AND n.revision_id=p_build
 ;
 IF bad_owner_ THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'native orphan or repeated containment owner' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF unreachable_ THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'native containment cycle or unreachable record'
 USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM kb.pdf_record_access parent JOIN kb.pdf_record_access child ON
 child.product_id=parent.product_id AND child.revision_id=parent.revision_id
 AND child.parent_pointer=parent.pointer
 WHERE parent.product_id=p_build AND parent.revision_id=p_build AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM
 jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(parent.native_json->'children','[]')) c WHERE
 c->>'$ref'=child.pointer))
 OR EXISTS(SELECT FROM kb.pdf_record_access parent CROSS JOIN LATERAL
 jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(parent.native_json->'children','[]')) c
 LEFT JOIN kb.pdf_record_access child ON child.product_id=p_build AND
 child.revision_id=p_build AND child.pointer=c->>'$ref'
 WHERE parent.product_id=p_build AND parent.revision_id=p_build AND (child.pointer IS NULL OR
 child.parent_pointer IS DISTINCT FROM parent.pointer)) THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'native parent/child backpointer differs' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM kb.pdf_record_native n CROSS JOIN LATERAL
 jsonb_each(n.structure_json->'fields') f
 LEFT JOIN kb.pdf_record_native target ON target.product_id=p_build AND
 target.revision_id=p_build AND target.record_id=f.value->>'target'
 WHERE n.product_id=p_build AND n.revision_id=p_build AND f.value->>'kind'='object' AND
 target.record_id IS NULL) THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'missing native object target' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF EXISTS(WITH member_counts AS (
 SELECT parent_id,field_name,count(*) count_,min(ordinal) min_,max(ordinal) max_
 FROM kb.pdf_record_membership WHERE product_id=p_build AND revision_id=p_build
 GROUP BY parent_id,field_name
 ) SELECT FROM kb.pdf_record_native n CROSS JOIN LATERAL
 jsonb_each(n.structure_json->'fields') f LEFT JOIN member_counts members
 ON members.parent_id=n.record_id AND members.field_name=f.key
 WHERE n.product_id=p_build AND n.revision_id=p_build AND f.value->>'kind' IN ('array','map')
 AND
 (COALESCE(members.count_,0)<>(f.value->>'length')::bigint OR
 (members.count_>0 AND (members.min_<>0 OR members.max_<>members.count_-1)))) THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'native ordered membership incomplete' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM kb.pdf_record_native n LEFT JOIN ops.pdf_artifact_stream a ON
 a.product_id=p_build AND a.revision_id=p_build AND a.stream_id=n.native_address_stream_id
 WHERE n.product_id=p_build AND n.revision_id=p_build GROUP BY
 COALESCE(a.byte_length,octet_length(convert_to(n.native_address,'UTF8'))),
 COALESCE(a.byte_root,encode(ops.pdf_identity_byte_root(convert_to(n.native_address,'UTF8')),
 'hex')) HAVING count(*)>1) THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'duplicate native address including overflow representation' USING
 ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM kb.pdf_record_membership m LEFT JOIN ops.pdf_artifact_stream s ON
 s.product_id=p_build AND s.revision_id=p_build AND s.stream_id=m.member_key_stream_id
 WHERE m.product_id=p_build AND m.revision_id=p_build AND (m.member_key IS NOT NULL OR
 m.member_key_stream_id IS NOT NULL)
 GROUP BY
 m.parent_id,m.field_name,COALESCE(s.byte_length,octet_length(convert_to(m.member_key,'UTF8'))),
 COALESCE(s.byte_root,encode(ops.pdf_identity_byte_root(convert_to(m.member_key,'UTF8')),
 'hex')) HAVING count(*)>1) THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'duplicate native map key including overflow representation' USING
 ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM kb.pdf_record_reference r LEFT JOIN kb.pdf_record_native n
 ON n.product_id=p_build AND n.revision_id=p_build AND n.record_id=r.target_id WHERE
 r.product_id=p_build AND r.revision_id=p_build AND
 (n.record_id IS NULL OR (r.native_pointer IS NOT NULL AND r.field_name NOT IN
 ('source_cell_id','target_cell_id') AND NOT
 ops.pdf_reference_bytes_equal(p_build,p_build,n.native_address,n.native_address_stream_id,
 r.native_pointer,r.native_pointer_stream_id)))) THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'native reference/address target differs' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM kb.pdf_record_companion c LEFT JOIN ops.pdf_product input_ ON
 input_.task_id=(c.body->>'task_id')::bigint AND input_.product_key=c.body->>'product_key' AND
 input_.content_digest=c.body->>'content_digest'
 LEFT JOIN ops.task task_ ON task_.id=input_.task_id LEFT JOIN ops.run run_ ON
 run_.id=task_.run_id
 WHERE c.product_id=p_build AND c.revision_id=p_build AND c.family='input' AND
 (input_.task_id IS NULL OR input_.artifact_digest IS DISTINCT FROM b.source_digest OR
 run_.project_id IS DISTINCT FROM (SELECT project_id FROM ops.run WHERE id=b.run_id))) THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'PDF input outside exact admitted source/project custody' USING
 ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM kb.pdf_record_companion c CROSS JOIN LATERAL
 jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(c.body->'supports','[]')) support
 WHERE c.product_id=p_build AND c.revision_id=p_build AND c.family='coverage' AND NOT
 EXISTS(SELECT FROM kb.pdf_record_companion i
 WHERE i.product_id=p_build AND i.revision_id=p_build AND i.family='input' AND
 i.local_id=support->>'input_index')) THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'coverage support references missing input' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM kb.pdf_record_companion o LEFT JOIN kb.pdf_record_access a ON
 a.product_id=p_build AND a.revision_id=p_build AND a.pointer=o.body->>'pointer' WHERE
 o.product_id=p_build AND o.revision_id=p_build AND o.family='occurrence'
 AND o.body->>'address_space' IN ('native_item','selected_item','native_cell') AND (a.pointer
 IS NULL OR
 (o.body ? 'cell_index' AND (o.body->>'cell_index')::bigint>=GREATEST(
 jsonb_array_length(COALESCE(a.native_json->'data'->'table_cells','[]')),
 jsonb_array_length(COALESCE(a.native_json->'meta'->'tabular_chart'->'chart_data'->'table_cells','[]')))))) THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'companion occurrence outside native item/cell inventory' USING
 ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM kb.pdf_record_endpoint e WHERE e.product_id=p_build AND
 e.revision_id=p_build AND
 ((e.target_task_id=0 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM kb.pdf_record_companion o WHERE
 o.product_id=p_build AND o.revision_id=p_build AND o.family='occurrence' AND
 o.local_id=e.occurrence_id)) OR
 (e.target_task_id<>0 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM ops.pdf_product p WHERE
 p.task_id=e.target_task_id AND p.product_key=e.target_product_key AND
 p.content_digest=e.target_content_digest AND (EXISTS(SELECT FROM kb.pdf_occurrence o WHERE
 o.task_id=p.task_id AND o.product_key=p.product_key AND o.occurrence_id=e.occurrence_id) OR
 EXISTS(SELECT FROM ops.pdf_published_revision pr JOIN kb.pdf_record_companion c ON
 c.product_id=pr.build_id AND c.revision_id=pr.build_id
 WHERE pr.task_id=p.task_id AND pr.product_key=p.product_key AND
 pr.logical_digest=p.content_digest AND c.family='occurrence' AND
 c.local_id=e.occurrence_id)))))) THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'companion endpoint outside admitted occurrence inventory' USING
 ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM kb.pdf_record_companion c WHERE c.product_id=p_build AND
 c.revision_id=p_build AND c.family='native_metadata'
 AND (c.body ? 'value' OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM kb.pdf_record_companion_field f WHERE
 f.product_id=c.product_id AND f.revision_id=c.revision_id
 AND f.family=c.family AND f.local_id=c.local_id AND f.field_name='value'))) THEN RAISE
 EXCEPTION 'metadata value has no governed byte field'; END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM kb.pdf_record_companion_field f JOIN kb.pdf_record_companion c
 USING(product_id,revision_id,family,local_id)
 JOIN ops.pdf_artifact_stream a USING(product_id,revision_id,stream_id) WHERE
 f.product_id=p_build AND f.revision_id=p_build
 AND (c.body ? f.field_name OR a.encoding_profile IS DISTINCT FROM CASE WHEN
 f.field_name='value' THEN CASE WHEN c.body->>'kind'='inline_candidate_pages' THEN
 'pdf-ocr-candidate-ipc-v1' ELSE 'pdf-companion-json-field-v1' END ELSE 'pdf-record-scalar-v1:s'
 END))
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid final companion field'; END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM kb.pdf_record_native n WHERE n.product_id=p_build AND
 n.revision_id=p_build AND n.native_type IN
 ('TextItem','ListItem','SectionHeaderItem','FormulaItem','CodeItem','GroupItem','ListGroup',
 'PictureItem','TableItem')
 AND n.scalars_json ? 'self_ref' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM kb.pdf_record_access a WHERE
 a.product_id=p_build AND a.revision_id=p_build
 AND a.pointer=n.scalars_json->>'self_ref')) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION
 'native access inventory incomplete' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 PERFORM ops.pdf_check_access_correspondence(p_build);
 logical_:=ops.pdf_record_logical_identity(p_build,p_build);
 PERFORM ops.require_pdf_frozen(p_build,p_task,p_attempt,p_holder,p_frozen);
 contract_:=ops.pdf_projection_contract(p_build,b.release_id);
 INSERT INTO ops.pdf_build_validation SELECT p_build,p_frozen,logical_,contract_,v.passed,
 v.contract_digest FROM ops.pdf_native_validation v WHERE v.build_id=p_build AND
 v.frozen_digest=p_frozen AND v.passed AND
 v.contract_digest=ops.pdf_validation_contract(b.release_id) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM ops.pdf_build_validation WHERE build_id=p_build AND
 frozen_digest=p_frozen AND logical_digest=logical_ AND contract_digest=contract_ AND
 native_contract_digest=ops.pdf_validation_contract(b.release_id) AND native_callbacks) THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'PDF validation result differs for frozen premises' USING ERRCODE='23514';
 END IF;
 RETURN QUERY SELECT * FROM ops.pdf_build_validation WHERE build_id=p_build AND
 frozen_digest=p_frozen AND contract_digest=contract_;
END
catalog.result: SETOF ops.pdf_build_validation

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION ops.validate_pdf_build(p_build text,p_task bigint,p_attempt
 bigint,p_holder text,p_frozen text)
RETURNS SETOF ops.pdf_build_validation LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET
 search_path=pg_catalog,pg_temp AS $$
DECLARE b ops.pdf_stage_build; logical_ text; contract_ text;
 prior_validation ops.pdf_build_validation; bad_owner_ boolean; unreachable_ boolean;
BEGIN
 PERFORM 1 FROM ops.pdf_stage_build WHERE build_id=p_build FOR NO KEY UPDATE;
 b:=ops.require_pdf_frozen(p_build,p_task,p_attempt,p_holder,p_frozen);
 PERFORM sem.require_execution_operation(b.release_id,'validate_pdf_build');
 SELECT * INTO prior_validation FROM ops.lookup_pdf_validation(
 p_build,p_task,p_attempt,p_holder,p_frozen);
 IF FOUND THEN RETURN NEXT prior_validation; RETURN; END IF;
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM ops.pdf_native_validation v WHERE v.build_id=p_build AND
 v.frozen_digest=p_frozen AND v.contract_digest=ops.pdf_validation_contract(b.release_id)
 AND v.passed) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'native callback conformance outcome missing or stale'
 USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM kb.pdf_record_native n WHERE n.product_id=p_build AND
 n.revision_id=p_build AND
 ops.pdf_native_record_shape(n.native_type,n.scalars_json,n.structure_json->'fields') IS NOT
 TRUE) THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'native schema field/required/primitive constraint differs' USING
 ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM kb.pdf_record_native n WHERE n.product_id=p_build AND
 n.revision_id=p_build AND
 (jsonb_typeof(n.structure_json->'fields') IS DISTINCT FROM 'object' OR
 EXISTS(SELECT FROM jsonb_each(n.structure_json->'fields') f WHERE f.value->>'kind' NOT IN
 ('object','array','map','parts')) OR
 EXISTS(SELECT FROM jsonb_object_keys(n.scalars_json) k WHERE n.structure_json->'fields' ?
 k))) THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid native field decomposition' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM kb.pdf_record_membership m LEFT JOIN kb.pdf_record_native n ON
 n.product_id=p_build AND n.revision_id=p_build AND n.record_id=m.parent_id
 WHERE m.product_id=p_build AND m.revision_id=p_build AND (n.record_id IS NULL OR
 n.structure_json->'fields'->m.field_name->>'kind' NOT IN ('array','map'))) THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'membership outside declared collection' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM kb.pdf_record_native n WHERE n.product_id=p_build AND
 n.revision_id=p_build AND n.scalars_json ? 'self_ref'
 GROUP BY n.scalars_json->>'self_ref' HAVING count(*)<>1) THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'native self-reference is not unique' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM kb.pdf_record_native n LEFT JOIN kb.pdf_record_reference r ON
 r.product_id=p_build AND r.revision_id=p_build AND r.source_id=n.record_id AND
 r.field_name='$ref'
 WHERE n.product_id=p_build AND n.revision_id=p_build AND n.native_type IN
 ('RefItem','FineRef') AND
 (r.reference_id IS NULL OR NOT
 ops.pdf_reference_bytes_equal(p_build,p_build,r.native_pointer,r.native_pointer_stream_id,
 n.scalars_json->>'$ref',n.structure_json->'fields'->'$ref'->>'stream_id'))) THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'native reference index does not correspond to supplied spelling' USING
 ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 WITH RECURSIVE owner_edges AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT n.record_id parent_id,f.value->>'target' child_id FROM kb.pdf_record_native n
 CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each(n.structure_json->'fields') f
 WHERE n.product_id=p_build AND n.revision_id=p_build AND f.value->>'kind'='object'
 UNION ALL SELECT parent_id,record_id FROM kb.pdf_record_membership
 WHERE product_id=p_build AND revision_id=p_build AND value_kind='record'
 ), owner_counts AS (
 SELECT child_id,count(parent_id) owners FROM owner_edges GROUP BY child_id
 ), reachable(record_id) AS (
 SELECT root_id FROM ops.pdf_record_document
 WHERE product_id=p_build AND revision_id=p_build
 UNION SELECT e.child_id FROM reachable r JOIN owner_edges e ON e.parent_id=r.record_id
 ) SELECT COALESCE(bool_or(COALESCE(owners.owners,0)<>CASE WHEN n.record_id=(
 SELECT root_id FROM ops.pdf_record_document
 WHERE product_id=p_build AND revision_id=p_build) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END),true),
 COALESCE(bool_or(reachable.record_id IS NULL),true) INTO bad_owner_,unreachable_
 FROM kb.pdf_record_native n LEFT JOIN owner_counts owners ON owners.child_id=n.record_id
 LEFT JOIN reachable ON reachable.record_id=n.record_id
 WHERE n.product_id=p_build AND n.revision_id=p_build
 ;
 IF bad_owner_ THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'native orphan or repeated containment owner' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF unreachable_ THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'native containment cycle or unreachable record'
 USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM kb.pdf_record_access parent JOIN kb.pdf_record_access child ON
 child.product_id=parent.product_id AND child.revision_id=parent.revision_id
 AND child.parent_pointer=parent.pointer
 WHERE parent.product_id=p_build AND parent.revision_id=p_build AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM
 jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(parent.native_json->'children','[]')) c WHERE
 c->>'$ref'=child.pointer))
 OR EXISTS(SELECT FROM kb.pdf_record_access parent CROSS JOIN LATERAL
 jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(parent.native_json->'children','[]')) c
 LEFT JOIN kb.pdf_record_access child ON child.product_id=p_build AND
 child.revision_id=p_build AND child.pointer=c->>'$ref'
 WHERE parent.product_id=p_build AND parent.revision_id=p_build AND (child.pointer IS NULL OR
 child.parent_pointer IS DISTINCT FROM parent.pointer)) THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'native parent/child backpointer differs' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM kb.pdf_record_native n CROSS JOIN LATERAL
 jsonb_each(n.structure_json->'fields') f
 LEFT JOIN kb.pdf_record_native target ON target.product_id=p_build AND
 target.revision_id=p_build AND target.record_id=f.value->>'target'
 WHERE n.product_id=p_build AND n.revision_id=p_build AND f.value->>'kind'='object' AND
 target.record_id IS NULL) THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'missing native object target' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF EXISTS(WITH member_counts AS (
 SELECT parent_id,field_name,count(*) count_,min(ordinal) min_,max(ordinal) max_
 FROM kb.pdf_record_membership WHERE product_id=p_build AND revision_id=p_build
 GROUP BY parent_id,field_name
 ) SELECT FROM kb.pdf_record_native n CROSS JOIN LATERAL
 jsonb_each(n.structure_json->'fields') f LEFT JOIN member_counts members
 ON members.parent_id=n.record_id AND members.field_name=f.key
 WHERE n.product_id=p_build AND n.revision_id=p_build AND f.value->>'kind' IN ('array','map')
 AND
 (COALESCE(members.count_,0)<>(f.value->>'length')::bigint OR
 (members.count_>0 AND (members.min_<>0 OR members.max_<>members.count_-1)))) THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'native ordered membership incomplete' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM kb.pdf_record_native n LEFT JOIN ops.pdf_artifact_stream a ON
 a.product_id=p_build AND a.revision_id=p_build AND a.stream_id=n.native_address_stream_id
 WHERE n.product_id=p_build AND n.revision_id=p_build GROUP BY
 COALESCE(a.byte_length,octet_length(convert_to(n.native_address,'UTF8'))),
 COALESCE(a.byte_root,encode(ops.pdf_identity_byte_root(convert_to(n.native_address,'UTF8')),
 'hex')) HAVING count(*)>1) THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'duplicate native address including overflow representation' USING
 ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM kb.pdf_record_membership m LEFT JOIN ops.pdf_artifact_stream s ON
 s.product_id=p_build AND s.revision_id=p_build AND s.stream_id=m.member_key_stream_id
 WHERE m.product_id=p_build AND m.revision_id=p_build AND (m.member_key IS NOT NULL OR
 m.member_key_stream_id IS NOT NULL)
 GROUP BY
 m.parent_id,m.field_name,COALESCE(s.byte_length,octet_length(convert_to(m.member_key,'UTF8'))),
 COALESCE(s.byte_root,encode(ops.pdf_identity_byte_root(convert_to(m.member_key,'UTF8')),
 'hex')) HAVING count(*)>1) THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'duplicate native map key including overflow representation' USING
 ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM kb.pdf_record_reference r LEFT JOIN kb.pdf_record_native n
 ON n.product_id=p_build AND n.revision_id=p_build AND n.record_id=r.target_id WHERE
 r.product_id=p_build AND r.revision_id=p_build AND
 (n.record_id IS NULL OR (r.native_pointer IS NOT NULL AND r.field_name NOT IN
 ('source_cell_id','target_cell_id') AND NOT
 ops.pdf_reference_bytes_equal(p_build,p_build,n.native_address,n.native_address_stream_id,
 r.native_pointer,r.native_pointer_stream_id)))) THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'native reference/address target differs' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM kb.pdf_record_companion c LEFT JOIN ops.pdf_product input_ ON
 input_.task_id=(c.body->>'task_id')::bigint AND input_.product_key=c.body->>'product_key' AND
 input_.content_digest=c.body->>'content_digest'
 LEFT JOIN ops.task task_ ON task_.id=input_.task_id LEFT JOIN ops.run run_ ON
 run_.id=task_.run_id
 WHERE c.product_id=p_build AND c.revision_id=p_build AND c.family='input' AND
 (input_.task_id IS NULL OR input_.artifact_digest IS DISTINCT FROM b.source_digest OR
 run_.project_id IS DISTINCT FROM (SELECT project_id FROM ops.run WHERE id=b.run_id))) THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'PDF input outside exact admitted source/project custody' USING
 ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM kb.pdf_record_companion c CROSS JOIN LATERAL
 jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(c.body->'supports','[]')) support
 WHERE c.product_id=p_build AND c.revision_id=p_build AND c.family='coverage' AND NOT
 EXISTS(SELECT FROM kb.pdf_record_companion i
 WHERE i.product_id=p_build AND i.revision_id=p_build AND i.family='input' AND
 i.local_id=support->>'input_index')) THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'coverage support references missing input' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM kb.pdf_record_companion o LEFT JOIN kb.pdf_record_access a ON
 a.product_id=p_build AND a.revision_id=p_build AND a.pointer=o.body->>'pointer' WHERE
 o.product_id=p_build AND o.revision_id=p_build AND o.family='occurrence'
 AND o.body->>'address_space' IN ('native_item','selected_item','native_cell') AND (a.pointer
 IS NULL OR
 (o.body ? 'cell_index' AND (o.body->>'cell_index')::bigint>=GREATEST(
 jsonb_array_length(COALESCE(a.native_json->'data'->'table_cells','[]')),
 jsonb_array_length(COALESCE(a.native_json->'meta'->'tabular_chart'->'chart_data'->'table_cells','[]')))))) THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'companion occurrence outside native item/cell inventory' USING
 ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM kb.pdf_record_endpoint e WHERE e.product_id=p_build AND
 e.revision_id=p_build AND
 ((e.target_task_id=0 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM kb.pdf_record_companion o WHERE
 o.product_id=p_build AND o.revision_id=p_build AND o.family='occurrence' AND
 o.local_id=e.occurrence_id)) OR
 (e.target_task_id<>0 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM ops.pdf_product p WHERE
 p.task_id=e.target_task_id AND p.product_key=e.target_product_key AND
 p.content_digest=e.target_content_digest AND (EXISTS(SELECT FROM kb.pdf_occurrence o WHERE
 o.task_id=p.task_id AND o.product_key=p.product_key AND o.occurrence_id=e.occurrence_id) OR
 EXISTS(SELECT FROM ops.pdf_published_revision pr JOIN kb.pdf_record_companion c ON
 c.product_id=pr.build_id AND c.revision_id=pr.build_id
 WHERE pr.task_id=p.task_id AND pr.product_key=p.product_key AND
 pr.logical_digest=p.content_digest AND c.family='occurrence' AND
 c.local_id=e.occurrence_id)))))) THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'companion endpoint outside admitted occurrence inventory' USING
 ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM kb.pdf_record_companion c WHERE c.product_id=p_build AND
 c.revision_id=p_build AND c.family='native_metadata'
 AND (c.body ? 'value' OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM kb.pdf_record_companion_field f WHERE
 f.product_id=c.product_id AND f.revision_id=c.revision_id
 AND f.family=c.family AND f.local_id=c.local_id AND f.field_name='value'))) THEN RAISE
 EXCEPTION 'metadata value has no governed byte field'; END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM kb.pdf_record_companion_field f JOIN kb.pdf_record_companion c
 USING(product_id,revision_id,family,local_id)
 JOIN ops.pdf_artifact_stream a USING(product_id,revision_id,stream_id) WHERE
 f.product_id=p_build AND f.revision_id=p_build
 AND (c.body ? f.field_name OR a.encoding_profile IS DISTINCT FROM CASE WHEN
 f.field_name='value' THEN CASE WHEN c.body->>'kind'='inline_candidate_pages' THEN
 'pdf-ocr-candidate-ipc-v1' ELSE 'pdf-companion-json-field-v1' END ELSE 'pdf-record-scalar-v1:s'
 END))
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid final companion field'; END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM kb.pdf_record_native n WHERE n.product_id=p_build AND
 n.revision_id=p_build AND n.native_type IN
 ('TextItem','ListItem','SectionHeaderItem','FormulaItem','CodeItem','GroupItem','ListGroup',
 'PictureItem','TableItem')
 AND n.scalars_json ? 'self_ref' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM kb.pdf_record_access a WHERE
 a.product_id=p_build AND a.revision_id=p_build
 AND a.pointer=n.scalars_json->>'self_ref')) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION
 'native access inventory incomplete' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 PERFORM ops.pdf_check_access_correspondence(p_build);
 logical_:=ops.pdf_record_logical_identity(p_build,p_build);
 PERFORM ops.require_pdf_frozen(p_build,p_task,p_attempt,p_holder,p_frozen);
 contract_:=ops.pdf_projection_contract(p_build,b.release_id);
 INSERT INTO ops.pdf_build_validation SELECT p_build,p_frozen,logical_,contract_,v.passed,
 v.contract_digest FROM ops.pdf_native_validation v WHERE v.build_id=p_build AND
 v.frozen_digest=p_frozen AND v.passed AND
 v.contract_digest=ops.pdf_validation_contract(b.release_id) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM ops.pdf_build_validation WHERE build_id=p_build AND
 frozen_digest=p_frozen AND logical_digest=logical_ AND contract_digest=contract_ AND
 native_contract_digest=ops.pdf_validation_contract(b.release_id) AND native_callbacks) THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'PDF validation result differs for frozen premises' USING ERRCODE='23514';
 END IF;
 RETURN QUERY SELECT * FROM ops.pdf_build_validation WHERE build_id=p_build AND
 frozen_digest=p_frozen AND contract_digest=contract_;
END $$

catalog.body:
BEGIN
 IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM kb.pdf_record_access a LEFT JOIN kb.pdf_record_native n
 ON n.product_id=p_build AND n.revision_id=p_build AND n.native_address=a.pointer
 WHERE a.product_id=p_build AND (a.revision_id<>p_build OR n.record_id IS NULL OR
 a.native_json->>'self_ref' IS DISTINCT FROM a.pointer OR
 a.label IS DISTINCT FROM COALESCE(a.native_json->>'label','unspecified') OR
 a.content_layer IS DISTINCT FROM COALESCE(a.native_json->>'content_layer','body') OR
 a.text IS DISTINCT FROM a.native_json->>'text' OR
 a.parent_pointer IS DISTINCT FROM a.native_json#>>'{parent,$ref}')) THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'native access fields do not correspond to frozen native item' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;

 IF EXISTS(WITH RECURSIVE projected(record_id,value) AS (
  SELECT n.record_id,a.native_json FROM kb.pdf_record_access a JOIN kb.pdf_record_native n
  ON n.product_id=p_build AND n.revision_id=p_build AND n.native_address=a.pointer WHERE a.product_id=p_build AND a.revision_id=p_build
  UNION ALL
  SELECT child.record_id,child.value FROM projected w JOIN kb.pdf_record_native n
  ON n.product_id=p_build AND n.revision_id=p_build AND n.record_id=w.record_id
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
   SELECT f.value->>'target' AS record_id,w.value->f.key AS value
   FROM jsonb_each(n.structure_json->'fields') f WHERE f.value->>'kind'='object'
   UNION ALL
   SELECT m.record_id,CASE WHEN f.value->>'kind'='map' THEN container.value->COALESCE(m.member_key,ops.pdf_projection_stream_value(p_build,m.member_key_stream_id)#>>'{}') ELSE container.value->m.ordinal::integer END
   FROM jsonb_each(n.structure_json->'fields') f JOIN kb.pdf_record_membership m
   ON m.product_id=p_build AND m.revision_id=p_build AND m.parent_id=w.record_id AND m.field_name=f.key
   CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT CASE WHEN n.native_type='NativeArray' AND f.key='items' THEN w.value ELSE w.value->f.key END value) container
   WHERE f.value->>'kind' IN ('array','map') AND m.value_kind='record'
  ) child
 ) CYCLE record_id SET cycle_ USING path_
 SELECT FROM projected w LEFT JOIN kb.pdf_record_native n
 ON n.product_id=p_build AND n.revision_id=p_build AND n.record_id=w.record_id
 WHERE w.cycle_ OR n.record_id IS NULL OR w.value IS NULL OR
 (n.native_type='NativeArray' AND jsonb_typeof(w.value)<>'array') OR
 (n.native_type<>'NativeArray' AND (jsonb_typeof(w.value)<>'object' OR
  CASE WHEN n.structure_json ? 'extensions' THEN
    ops.pdf_projection_stream_matches(p_build,n.structure_json->'extensions'->>'stream_id',
     w.value-ARRAY(SELECT jsonb_object_keys(n.scalars_json) UNION SELECT jsonb_object_keys(n.structure_json->'fields'))) IS NOT TRUE
  ELSE w.value-ARRAY(SELECT jsonb_object_keys(n.scalars_json) UNION SELECT jsonb_object_keys(n.structure_json->'fields'))<>'{}'::jsonb END)) OR
 EXISTS(SELECT FROM jsonb_each(n.scalars_json) s WHERE ops.pdf_projection_scalar_matches(w.value->s.key,s.value) IS NOT TRUE) OR
 EXISTS(SELECT FROM jsonb_each(n.structure_json->'fields') f
 CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT CASE WHEN n.native_type='NativeArray' AND f.key='items' THEN w.value ELSE w.value->f.key END value) container
 WHERE container.value IS NULL OR
 (f.value->>'kind'='object' AND jsonb_typeof(container.value)<>'object') OR
 (f.value->>'kind'='parts' AND ops.pdf_projection_stream_matches(p_build,f.value->>'stream_id',container.value) IS NOT TRUE) OR
 (f.value->>'kind'='array' AND (jsonb_typeof(container.value)<>'array' OR jsonb_array_length(container.value)<>(f.value->>'length')::bigint)) OR
 (f.value->>'kind'='map' AND (jsonb_typeof(container.value)<>'object' OR (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_object_keys(container.value))<>(f.value->>'length')::bigint)) OR
 EXISTS(SELECT FROM kb.pdf_record_membership m
 CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT CASE WHEN f.value->>'kind'='map' THEN container.value->COALESCE(m.member_key,ops.pdf_projection_stream_value(p_build,m.member_key_stream_id)#>>'{}') ELSE container.value->m.ordinal::integer END value) actual
 WHERE m.product_id=p_build AND m.revision_id=p_build AND m.parent_id=w.record_id AND m.field_name=f.key AND
 (actual.value IS NULL OR (m.value_kind='scalar' AND ops.pdf_projection_scalar_matches(actual.value,m.scalar_json) IS NOT TRUE) OR
 (m.value_kind='parts' AND ops.pdf_projection_stream_matches(p_build,m.stream_id,actual.value) IS NOT TRUE))))) THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'native access JSON differs from frozen record fields/members/scalars' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;

 IF EXISTS(WITH RECURSIVE ancestry(pointer,owner,depth) AS (
  SELECT pointer,pointer,0 FROM kb.pdf_record_access WHERE product_id=p_build AND revision_id=p_build
  UNION ALL SELECT a.pointer,parent.pointer,a.depth+1 FROM ancestry a JOIN kb.pdf_record_access child
  ON child.product_id=p_build AND child.revision_id=p_build AND child.pointer=a.owner JOIN kb.pdf_record_access parent
  ON parent.product_id=p_build AND parent.revision_id=p_build AND parent.pointer=child.parent_pointer
 ) CYCLE owner SET cycle_ USING path_, nearest AS (
 SELECT DISTINCT ON (n.pointer) n.pointer,n.owner FROM ancestry n JOIN kb.pdf_record_access section
 ON section.product_id=p_build AND section.revision_id=p_build AND section.pointer=n.owner
 WHERE section.label IN ('section','chapter') ORDER BY n.pointer,n.depth
 ), cycles AS (SELECT DISTINCT pointer FROM ancestry WHERE cycle_)
 SELECT FROM kb.pdf_record_access a LEFT JOIN nearest n ON n.pointer=a.pointer
 LEFT JOIN cycles c ON c.pointer=a.pointer WHERE a.product_id=p_build AND a.revision_id=p_build AND
 (c.pointer IS NOT NULL OR a.section_pointer IS DISTINCT FROM n.owner)) THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'native access section owner differs from native ancestry' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;

 IF EXISTS(WITH RECURSIVE roots(pointer,path) AS (
  SELECT target.scalars_json->>'self_ref',ARRAY[CASE f.key WHEN 'body' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END]::bigint[]
  FROM ops.pdf_record_document h JOIN kb.pdf_record_native root ON root.product_id=p_build AND root.revision_id=p_build AND root.record_id=h.root_id
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each(root.structure_json->'fields') f JOIN kb.pdf_record_native target
  ON target.product_id=p_build AND target.revision_id=p_build AND target.record_id=f.value->>'target' WHERE h.product_id=p_build AND h.revision_id=p_build AND f.key IN ('body','furniture')
 ), traversal(pointer,path) AS (
 SELECT pointer,path FROM roots UNION ALL
 SELECT c.value->>'$ref',t.path||(c.ordinality-1) FROM traversal t JOIN kb.pdf_record_access a
 ON a.product_id=p_build AND a.revision_id=p_build AND a.pointer=t.pointer CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(a.native_json->'children','[]')) WITH ORDINALITY c
 ) CYCLE pointer SET cycle_ USING cycle_path_
 SELECT FROM (SELECT a.pointer,a.ordinal,row_number() OVER(ORDER BY CASE WHEN t.pointer IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,t.path,a.pointer COLLATE "C")-1 expected,t.cycle_
 FROM kb.pdf_record_access a LEFT JOIN traversal t ON t.pointer=a.pointer WHERE a.product_id=p_build AND a.revision_id=p_build) ordered
 WHERE ordinal<>expected OR cycle_) THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'native access order differs from native containment traversal' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;

 IF EXISTS(WITH region_counts AS (
 SELECT pointer,count(*) count_ FROM kb.pdf_record_region
 WHERE product_id=p_build AND revision_id=p_build GROUP BY pointer
 ) SELECT FROM kb.pdf_record_access a LEFT JOIN region_counts counts ON counts.pointer=a.pointer
 WHERE a.product_id=p_build AND a.revision_id=p_build AND
 COALESCE(counts.count_,0)<>jsonb_array_length(COALESCE(a.native_json->'prov','[]'))) OR
 EXISTS(WITH page_sizes AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT pages.member_key,page_size.scalars_json AS dimensions
 FROM ops.pdf_record_document h JOIN kb.pdf_record_membership pages
 ON pages.product_id=p_build AND pages.revision_id=p_build
 AND pages.parent_id=h.root_id AND pages.field_name='pages'
 LEFT JOIN kb.pdf_record_native page ON page.product_id=p_build AND page.revision_id=p_build
 AND page.record_id=pages.record_id
 LEFT JOIN kb.pdf_record_native page_size ON page_size.product_id=p_build
 AND page_size.revision_id=p_build
 AND page_size.record_id=page.structure_json->'fields'->'size'->>'target'
 WHERE h.product_id=p_build AND h.revision_id=p_build
 ) SELECT FROM kb.pdf_record_region r LEFT JOIN kb.pdf_record_access a ON a.product_id=p_build AND a.revision_id=p_build AND a.pointer=r.pointer
 LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT a.native_json->'prov'->r.region_index::integer value) prov ON true
 LEFT JOIN page_sizes size ON size.member_key=r.page_no::text
 WHERE r.product_id=p_build AND (r.revision_id<>p_build OR a.pointer IS NULL OR prov.value IS NULL OR
 (prov.value->>'page_no')::bigint IS DISTINCT FROM r.page_no OR
 ops.pdf_projection_scalar_matches(to_jsonb(r.page_width),size.dimensions->'width') IS NOT TRUE OR
 ops.pdf_projection_scalar_matches(to_jsonb(r.page_height),size.dimensions->'height') IS NOT TRUE OR
 to_jsonb(r.left) IS DISTINCT FROM prov.value->'bbox'->'l' OR to_jsonb(r.top) IS DISTINCT FROM prov.value->'bbox'->'t' OR
 to_jsonb(r.right) IS DISTINCT FROM prov.value->'bbox'->'r' OR to_jsonb(r.bottom) IS DISTINCT FROM prov.value->'bbox'->'b' OR
 r.origin IS DISTINCT FROM CASE prov.value->'bbox'->>'coord_origin' WHEN 'TOPLEFT' THEN 'top_left' WHEN 'BOTTOMLEFT' THEN 'bottom_left' END)) THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'native access regions differ from native provenance/pages' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
END
catalog.result: void

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION ops.pdf_check_access_correspondence(p_build text)
RETURNS void LANGUAGE plpgsql STABLE SET search_path=pg_catalog,pg_temp AS $$
BEGIN
 IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM kb.pdf_record_access a LEFT JOIN kb.pdf_record_native n
 ON n.product_id=p_build AND n.revision_id=p_build AND n.native_address=a.pointer
 WHERE a.product_id=p_build AND (a.revision_id<>p_build OR n.record_id IS NULL OR
 a.native_json->>'self_ref' IS DISTINCT FROM a.pointer OR
 a.label IS DISTINCT FROM COALESCE(a.native_json->>'label','unspecified') OR
 a.content_layer IS DISTINCT FROM COALESCE(a.native_json->>'content_layer','body') OR
 a.text IS DISTINCT FROM a.native_json->>'text' OR
 a.parent_pointer IS DISTINCT FROM a.native_json#>>'{parent,$ref}')) THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'native access fields do not correspond to frozen native item' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;

 IF EXISTS(WITH RECURSIVE projected(record_id,value) AS (
  SELECT n.record_id,a.native_json FROM kb.pdf_record_access a JOIN kb.pdf_record_native n
  ON n.product_id=p_build AND n.revision_id=p_build AND n.native_address=a.pointer WHERE a.product_id=p_build AND a.revision_id=p_build
  UNION ALL
  SELECT child.record_id,child.value FROM projected w JOIN kb.pdf_record_native n
  ON n.product_id=p_build AND n.revision_id=p_build AND n.record_id=w.record_id
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
   SELECT f.value->>'target' AS record_id,w.value->f.key AS value
   FROM jsonb_each(n.structure_json->'fields') f WHERE f.value->>'kind'='object'
   UNION ALL
   SELECT m.record_id,CASE WHEN f.value->>'kind'='map' THEN container.value->COALESCE(m.member_key,ops.pdf_projection_stream_value(p_build,m.member_key_stream_id)#>>'{}') ELSE container.value->m.ordinal::integer END
   FROM jsonb_each(n.structure_json->'fields') f JOIN kb.pdf_record_membership m
   ON m.product_id=p_build AND m.revision_id=p_build AND m.parent_id=w.record_id AND m.field_name=f.key
   CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT CASE WHEN n.native_type='NativeArray' AND f.key='items' THEN w.value ELSE w.value->f.key END value) container
   WHERE f.value->>'kind' IN ('array','map') AND m.value_kind='record'
  ) child
 ) CYCLE record_id SET cycle_ USING path_
 SELECT FROM projected w LEFT JOIN kb.pdf_record_native n
 ON n.product_id=p_build AND n.revision_id=p_build AND n.record_id=w.record_id
 WHERE w.cycle_ OR n.record_id IS NULL OR w.value IS NULL OR
 (n.native_type='NativeArray' AND jsonb_typeof(w.value)<>'array') OR
 (n.native_type<>'NativeArray' AND (jsonb_typeof(w.value)<>'object' OR
  CASE WHEN n.structure_json ? 'extensions' THEN
    ops.pdf_projection_stream_matches(p_build,n.structure_json->'extensions'->>'stream_id',
     w.value-ARRAY(SELECT jsonb_object_keys(n.scalars_json) UNION SELECT jsonb_object_keys(n.structure_json->'fields'))) IS NOT TRUE
  ELSE w.value-ARRAY(SELECT jsonb_object_keys(n.scalars_json) UNION SELECT jsonb_object_keys(n.structure_json->'fields'))<>'{}'::jsonb END)) OR
 EXISTS(SELECT FROM jsonb_each(n.scalars_json) s WHERE ops.pdf_projection_scalar_matches(w.value->s.key,s.value) IS NOT TRUE) OR
 EXISTS(SELECT FROM jsonb_each(n.structure_json->'fields') f
 CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT CASE WHEN n.native_type='NativeArray' AND f.key='items' THEN w.value ELSE w.value->f.key END value) container
 WHERE container.value IS NULL OR
 (f.value->>'kind'='object' AND jsonb_typeof(container.value)<>'object') OR
 (f.value->>'kind'='parts' AND ops.pdf_projection_stream_matches(p_build,f.value->>'stream_id',container.value) IS NOT TRUE) OR
 (f.value->>'kind'='array' AND (jsonb_typeof(container.value)<>'array' OR jsonb_array_length(container.value)<>(f.value->>'length')::bigint)) OR
 (f.value->>'kind'='map' AND (jsonb_typeof(container.value)<>'object' OR (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_object_keys(container.value))<>(f.value->>'length')::bigint)) OR
 EXISTS(SELECT FROM kb.pdf_record_membership m
 CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT CASE WHEN f.value->>'kind'='map' THEN container.value->COALESCE(m.member_key,ops.pdf_projection_stream_value(p_build,m.member_key_stream_id)#>>'{}') ELSE container.value->m.ordinal::integer END value) actual
 WHERE m.product_id=p_build AND m.revision_id=p_build AND m.parent_id=w.record_id AND m.field_name=f.key AND
 (actual.value IS NULL OR (m.value_kind='scalar' AND ops.pdf_projection_scalar_matches(actual.value,m.scalar_json) IS NOT TRUE) OR
 (m.value_kind='parts' AND ops.pdf_projection_stream_matches(p_build,m.stream_id,actual.value) IS NOT TRUE))))) THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'native access JSON differs from frozen record fields/members/scalars' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;

 IF EXISTS(WITH RECURSIVE ancestry(pointer,owner,depth) AS (
  SELECT pointer,pointer,0 FROM kb.pdf_record_access WHERE product_id=p_build AND revision_id=p_build
  UNION ALL SELECT a.pointer,parent.pointer,a.depth+1 FROM ancestry a JOIN kb.pdf_record_access child
  ON child.product_id=p_build AND child.revision_id=p_build AND child.pointer=a.owner JOIN kb.pdf_record_access parent
  ON parent.product_id=p_build AND parent.revision_id=p_build AND parent.pointer=child.parent_pointer
 ) CYCLE owner SET cycle_ USING path_, nearest AS (
 SELECT DISTINCT ON (n.pointer) n.pointer,n.owner FROM ancestry n JOIN kb.pdf_record_access section
 ON section.product_id=p_build AND section.revision_id=p_build AND section.pointer=n.owner
 WHERE section.label IN ('section','chapter') ORDER BY n.pointer,n.depth
 ), cycles AS (SELECT DISTINCT pointer FROM ancestry WHERE cycle_)
 SELECT FROM kb.pdf_record_access a LEFT JOIN nearest n ON n.pointer=a.pointer
 LEFT JOIN cycles c ON c.pointer=a.pointer WHERE a.product_id=p_build AND a.revision_id=p_build AND
 (c.pointer IS NOT NULL OR a.section_pointer IS DISTINCT FROM n.owner)) THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'native access section owner differs from native ancestry' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;

 IF EXISTS(WITH RECURSIVE roots(pointer,path) AS (
  SELECT target.scalars_json->>'self_ref',ARRAY[CASE f.key WHEN 'body' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END]::bigint[]
  FROM ops.pdf_record_document h JOIN kb.pdf_record_native root ON root.product_id=p_build AND root.revision_id=p_build AND root.record_id=h.root_id
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each(root.structure_json->'fields') f JOIN kb.pdf_record_native target
  ON target.product_id=p_build AND target.revision_id=p_build AND target.record_id=f.value->>'target' WHERE h.product_id=p_build AND h.revision_id=p_build AND f.key IN ('body','furniture')
 ), traversal(pointer,path) AS (
 SELECT pointer,path FROM roots UNION ALL
 SELECT c.value->>'$ref',t.path||(c.ordinality-1) FROM traversal t JOIN kb.pdf_record_access a
 ON a.product_id=p_build AND a.revision_id=p_build AND a.pointer=t.pointer CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(a.native_json->'children','[]')) WITH ORDINALITY c
 ) CYCLE pointer SET cycle_ USING cycle_path_
 SELECT FROM (SELECT a.pointer,a.ordinal,row_number() OVER(ORDER BY CASE WHEN t.pointer IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,t.path,a.pointer COLLATE "C")-1 expected,t.cycle_
 FROM kb.pdf_record_access a LEFT JOIN traversal t ON t.pointer=a.pointer WHERE a.product_id=p_build AND a.revision_id=p_build) ordered
 WHERE ordinal<>expected OR cycle_) THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'native access order differs from native containment traversal' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;

 IF EXISTS(WITH region_counts AS (
 SELECT pointer,count(*) count_ FROM kb.pdf_record_region
 WHERE product_id=p_build AND revision_id=p_build GROUP BY pointer
 ) SELECT FROM kb.pdf_record_access a LEFT JOIN region_counts counts ON counts.pointer=a.pointer
 WHERE a.product_id=p_build AND a.revision_id=p_build AND
 COALESCE(counts.count_,0)<>jsonb_array_length(COALESCE(a.native_json->'prov','[]'))) OR
 EXISTS(WITH page_sizes AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT pages.member_key,page_size.scalars_json AS dimensions
 FROM ops.pdf_record_document h JOIN kb.pdf_record_membership pages
 ON pages.product_id=p_build AND pages.revision_id=p_build
 AND pages.parent_id=h.root_id AND pages.field_name='pages'
 LEFT JOIN kb.pdf_record_native page ON page.product_id=p_build AND page.revision_id=p_build
 AND page.record_id=pages.record_id
 LEFT JOIN kb.pdf_record_native page_size ON page_size.product_id=p_build
 AND page_size.revision_id=p_build
 AND page_size.record_id=page.structure_json->'fields'->'size'->>'target'
 WHERE h.product_id=p_build AND h.revision_id=p_build
 ) SELECT FROM kb.pdf_record_region r LEFT JOIN kb.pdf_record_access a ON a.product_id=p_build AND a.revision_id=p_build AND a.pointer=r.pointer
 LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT a.native_json->'prov'->r.region_index::integer value) prov ON true
 LEFT JOIN page_sizes size ON size.member_key=r.page_no::text
 WHERE r.product_id=p_build AND (r.revision_id<>p_build OR a.pointer IS NULL OR prov.value IS NULL OR
 (prov.value->>'page_no')::bigint IS DISTINCT FROM r.page_no OR
 ops.pdf_projection_scalar_matches(to_jsonb(r.page_width),size.dimensions->'width') IS NOT TRUE OR
 ops.pdf_projection_scalar_matches(to_jsonb(r.page_height),size.dimensions->'height') IS NOT TRUE OR
 to_jsonb(r.left) IS DISTINCT FROM prov.value->'bbox'->'l' OR to_jsonb(r.top) IS DISTINCT FROM prov.value->'bbox'->'t' OR
 to_jsonb(r.right) IS DISTINCT FROM prov.value->'bbox'->'r' OR to_jsonb(r.bottom) IS DISTINCT FROM prov.value->'bbox'->'b' OR
 r.origin IS DISTINCT FROM CASE prov.value->'bbox'->>'coord_origin' WHEN 'TOPLEFT' THEN 'top_left' WHEN 'BOTTOMLEFT' THEN 'bottom_left' END)) THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'native access regions differ from native provenance/pages' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
END $$
