catalog.arguments: p_project text, p_run bigint, p_release text, p_task bigint, p_product text, p_digest text, p_section text, p_membership text, p_policy text
catalog.body:
DECLARE revision ops.pdf_published_revision;
BEGIN
 IF p_section IS NULL OR p_membership IS DISTINCT FROM 'descendants'
 OR p_policy IS DISTINCT FROM 'section-source-context-v1' THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid selected source selector/policy' USING ERRCODE='22023'; END IF;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT revision FROM ops.require_published_companion_pin(
 p_project,p_run,p_release,p_task,p_product,p_digest);
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM kb.pdf_record_access a WHERE a.product_id=revision.build_id
 AND a.revision_id=revision.build_id AND a.pointer=p_section
 AND a.label IN ('section','chapter')) THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'selected source root is not a published section' USING ERRCODE='22023'; END IF;
 RETURN QUERY
WITH RECURSIVE published AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT * FROM ops.read_pdf_published_revision(p_task,p_product,p_digest)
), access AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT a.* FROM kb.pdf_record_access a JOIN published p
 ON a.product_id=p.build_id AND a.revision_id=p.build_id
 ), subtree(pointer) AS (
 SELECT pointer FROM access WHERE pointer=p_section
 UNION ALL SELECT child.pointer FROM access child JOIN subtree parent
 ON child.parent_pointer=parent.pointer
 ), selected AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT * FROM access WHERE pointer IN (SELECT pointer FROM subtree)
 ), ancestors(pointer) AS (
 SELECT parent_pointer FROM access WHERE pointer=p_section AND parent_pointer IS NOT NULL
 UNION SELECT a.parent_pointer FROM access a JOIN ancestors p ON a.pointer=p.pointer
 WHERE a.parent_pointer IS NOT NULL
 ), contained(record_id) AS (
 SELECT n.record_id FROM kb.pdf_record_native n JOIN published p
 ON n.product_id=p.build_id AND n.revision_id=p.build_id
 JOIN selected a ON a.pointer=n.native_address
 UNION
 SELECT child.record_id FROM contained parent JOIN kb.pdf_record_native n
 ON n.record_id=parent.record_id JOIN published p
 ON n.product_id=p.build_id AND n.revision_id=p.build_id
 CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
 SELECT f.value->>'target' AS record_id FROM jsonb_each(n.structure_json->'fields') f
 WHERE f.value->>'kind'='object'
 UNION ALL
 SELECT m.record_id FROM kb.pdf_record_membership m
 WHERE m.product_id=p.build_id AND m.revision_id=p.build_id
 AND m.parent_id=n.record_id AND m.value_kind='record'
 ) child
 ), selected_metadata AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT c.* FROM kb.pdf_record_companion c JOIN published p
 ON c.product_id=p.build_id AND c.revision_id=p.build_id
 WHERE c.family='native_metadata' AND CASE c.body->>'kind'
 WHEN 'formula_outcomes' THEN c.body->>'pointer' IN (SELECT pointer FROM selected)
 WHEN 'recognition_coverage' THEN
 (ops.pdf_companion_body(c.product_id,c.revision_id,c.family,c.local_id,c.body)
 ->'value'->>'section_pointer') IN
 (SELECT pointer FROM selected UNION SELECT pointer FROM ancestors)
 ELSE false END
 ), nodes AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT n.* FROM kb.pdf_record_native n JOIN published p ON n.product_id=p.build_id AND n.revision_id=p.build_id AND (n.record_id IN (SELECT record_id FROM contained))
), members AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT m.* FROM kb.pdf_record_membership m JOIN published p ON m.product_id=p.build_id AND m.revision_id=p.build_id AND m.parent_id IN (SELECT record_id FROM nodes)
), fields AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT record_id,name,value,kind,row_number() OVER(PARTITION BY record_id ORDER BY name COLLATE "C")-1 AS slot
 FROM (
 SELECT n.record_id,x.key AS name,x.value,'scalar'::text AS kind FROM nodes n
 CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each(n.scalars_json) x
 UNION ALL
 SELECT n.record_id,x.key,x.value,x.value->>'kind' FROM nodes n
 CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each(n.structure_json->'fields') x
 ) f
), edges AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT f.record_id AS parent_id,f.value->>'target' AS child_id,ARRAY[1,f.slot,1]::bigint[] AS suffix
 FROM fields f WHERE f.kind='object'
 UNION ALL
 SELECT m.parent_id,m.record_id,ARRAY[1,f.slot,1,1,m.ordinal,1]::bigint[] FROM members m
 JOIN fields f ON f.record_id=m.parent_id AND f.name=m.field_name WHERE m.value_kind='record'
), walk(record_id,path) AS (
 SELECT n.record_id,ARRAY[a.ordinal]::bigint[]
 FROM selected a JOIN nodes n ON n.native_address=a.pointer
 UNION ALL
 SELECT e.child_id,w.path||e.suffix FROM walk w JOIN edges e ON e.parent_id=w.record_id
), events(path,kind,value,prefix) AS (
 SELECT w.path||ARRAY[0]::bigint[],'literal',to_jsonb(CASE WHEN n.native_type='NativeArray' THEN '' ELSE '{' END),''
 FROM walk w JOIN nodes n USING(record_id)
 UNION ALL
 SELECT w.path||ARRAY[1,f.slot,0]::bigint[],'literal',to_jsonb(CASE WHEN n.native_type='NativeArray' THEN ''
 ELSE (CASE WHEN f.slot>0 THEN ',' ELSE '' END)||to_jsonb(f.name)::text||':' END),''
 FROM walk w JOIN nodes n USING(record_id) JOIN fields f USING(record_id)
 UNION ALL
 SELECT w.path||ARRAY[1,f.slot,1]::bigint[],CASE WHEN f.kind='scalar' THEN 'inline' ELSE 'parts' END,
 CASE WHEN f.kind='scalar' THEN f.value ELSE to_jsonb(f.value->>'stream_id') END,''
 FROM walk w JOIN fields f USING(record_id) WHERE f.kind IN ('scalar','parts')
 UNION ALL
 SELECT w.path||ARRAY[1,f.slot,1,0]::bigint[],'literal',to_jsonb(CASE WHEN f.kind='map' THEN '{' ELSE '[' END),''
 FROM walk w JOIN fields f USING(record_id) WHERE f.kind IN ('array','map')
 UNION ALL
 SELECT w.path||ARRAY[1,f.slot,1,1,m.ordinal,0]::bigint[],
 CASE WHEN f.kind='map' AND m.member_key IS NULL THEN 'key_parts' ELSE 'literal' END,
 CASE WHEN f.kind='map' AND m.member_key IS NULL THEN to_jsonb(m.member_key_stream_id)
 ELSE to_jsonb((CASE WHEN m.ordinal>0 THEN ',' ELSE '' END)||
 CASE WHEN f.kind='map' THEN to_jsonb(m.member_key)::text||':' ELSE '' END) END,
 CASE WHEN m.ordinal>0 THEN ',' ELSE '' END
 FROM walk w JOIN fields f USING(record_id) JOIN members m ON m.parent_id=f.record_id AND m.field_name=f.name
 WHERE f.kind IN ('array','map')
 UNION ALL
 SELECT w.path||ARRAY[1,f.slot,1,1,m.ordinal,1]::bigint[],
 CASE WHEN m.value_kind='scalar' THEN 'inline' ELSE 'parts' END,
 CASE WHEN m.value_kind='scalar' THEN m.scalar_json ELSE to_jsonb(m.stream_id) END,''
 FROM walk w JOIN fields f USING(record_id) JOIN members m ON m.parent_id=f.record_id AND m.field_name=f.name
 WHERE m.value_kind IN ('scalar','parts')
 UNION ALL
 SELECT w.path||ARRAY[1,f.slot,1,2]::bigint[],'literal',to_jsonb(CASE WHEN f.kind='map' THEN '}' ELSE ']' END),''
 FROM walk w JOIN fields f USING(record_id) WHERE f.kind IN ('array','map')
 UNION ALL
 SELECT w.path||ARRAY[1,(SELECT count(*) FROM fields f WHERE f.record_id=n.record_id),0]::bigint[],
 'extension',n.structure_json->'extensions'->'stream_id',
 CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT FROM fields f WHERE f.record_id=n.record_id) THEN ',' ELSE '' END
 FROM walk w JOIN nodes n USING(record_id) WHERE n.structure_json ? 'extensions'
 UNION ALL
 SELECT w.path||ARRAY[2]::bigint[],'literal',to_jsonb(CASE WHEN n.native_type='NativeArray' THEN '' ELSE '}' END),''
 FROM walk w JOIN nodes n USING(record_id)
),metadata_companions AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT * FROM selected_metadata
), metadata_fields AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT cf.*,c.ordinal AS row_ordinal FROM kb.pdf_record_companion_field cf
 JOIN metadata_companions c USING(product_id,revision_id,family,local_id)
), metadata_events(ordinal,local_id,phase,field_name,subphase,part_ordinal,event) AS (
 SELECT c.ordinal,c.local_id,0,''::text,0,0::bigint,jsonb_build_object('kind','row','body',c.body) FROM metadata_companions c
 UNION ALL
 SELECT f.row_ordinal,f.local_id,1,f.field_name,0,0::bigint,jsonb_build_object('kind','field','field',
 to_jsonb(s)||jsonb_build_object('field_name',f.field_name,'scalar_kind',f.scalar_kind))
 FROM metadata_fields f JOIN ops.pdf_artifact_stream s USING(product_id,revision_id,stream_id)
 UNION ALL
 SELECT f.row_ordinal,f.local_id,1,f.field_name,1,part.ordinal,jsonb_build_object('kind','part','part',to_jsonb(part))
 FROM metadata_fields f JOIN ops.pdf_artifact_part part USING(product_id,revision_id,stream_id)
 UNION ALL
 SELECT c.ordinal,c.local_id,2,''::text,0,0::bigint,jsonb_build_object('kind','close') FROM metadata_companions c
),
 companion AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT c.family,c.local_id,c.ordinal,c.body::text AS payload
 FROM ops.pdf_record_context_rows(p_task,p_product,p_digest,
 ARRAY(SELECT pointer FROM selected),p_section) c
 UNION ALL SELECT c.family,c.local_id,c.ordinal,
 c.body::text
 FROM kb.pdf_record_companion c JOIN published p
 ON c.product_id=p.build_id AND c.revision_id=p.build_id
 WHERE c.family='health'
 UNION ALL SELECT c.family,c.local_id,c.ordinal,c.body::text FROM selected_metadata c
 UNION ALL SELECT 'endpoint',e.relation_id||':'||e.ordinal::text,e.ordinal,
 jsonb_build_object('relation_id',e.relation_id,'endpoint_ordinal',e.ordinal,'role',e.role,
 'target_task_id',CASE WHEN e.target_task_id=0 THEN p_task ELSE e.target_task_id END,
 'target_product_key',CASE WHEN e.target_task_id=0 THEN p_product ELSE e.target_product_key END,
 'target_content_digest',CASE WHEN e.target_task_id=0
 THEN p_digest ELSE e.target_content_digest END,
 'occurrence_id',e.occurrence_id)::text
 FROM kb.pdf_record_endpoint e JOIN published p
 ON e.product_id=p.build_id AND e.revision_id=p.build_id
 WHERE e.relation_id IN (SELECT c.local_id FROM ops.pdf_record_context_rows(
 p_task,p_product,p_digest,ARRAY(SELECT pointer FROM selected),p_section) c
 WHERE c.family='relation')
 ), companion_order AS (
 SELECT *,row_number() OVER(ORDER BY family COLLATE "C",ordinal,local_id COLLATE "C") AS position
 FROM companion
 ), external AS (
 SELECT jsonb_build_object('from_pointer',a.pointer,'field',r.field_name,
 'reference_id',r.reference_id,'source_id',r.source_id,'native_address',origin.native_address,
 'source_ordinal',a.ordinal,'source_order',to_jsonb(w.path),
 'target',jsonb_build_object('task_id',p_task,'product_key',p_product,'content_digest',p_digest)||
 CASE WHEN r.field_name IN ('source_cell_id','target_cell_id')
 THEN jsonb_build_object('address_space','native_graph_cell','cell_id_lexical',r.native_pointer)
 ELSE jsonb_build_object('address_space','native_item','pointer',r.native_pointer) END,
 'resolution','qualified_external') AS body
 FROM selected a JOIN walk w ON w.path[1]=a.ordinal
 JOIN kb.pdf_record_reference r ON r.source_id=w.record_id
 JOIN nodes origin ON origin.record_id=r.source_id
 JOIN published p ON r.product_id=p.build_id AND r.revision_id=p.build_id
 WHERE r.native_pointer IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM nodes target
 WHERE target.record_id=r.target_id)
 UNION ALL
 SELECT jsonb_build_object('relation_id',e.relation_id,'endpoint_ordinal',e.ordinal,
 'role',e.role,'target',jsonb_build_object('task_id',CASE WHEN e.target_task_id=0
 THEN p_task ELSE e.target_task_id END,
 'product_key',CASE WHEN e.target_task_id=0 THEN p_product ELSE e.target_product_key END,
 'content_digest',CASE WHEN e.target_task_id=0 THEN p_digest ELSE e.target_content_digest END,
 'occurrence_id',e.occurrence_id),'resolution','qualified_external')
 FROM kb.pdf_record_endpoint e JOIN published p
 ON e.product_id=p.build_id AND e.revision_id=p.build_id
 WHERE e.relation_id IN (SELECT local_id FROM companion WHERE family='relation')
 AND NOT ((e.target_task_id,e.target_product_key,e.target_content_digest) IN
 ((p_task,p_product,p_digest),(0::bigint,'@self','@self'))
 AND e.occurrence_id IN (SELECT local_id FROM companion WHERE family='occurrence'))
 ), output(phase,path,event) AS (
 SELECT -1,ARRAY[]::bigint[],jsonb_build_object('event','selection_metadata',
 'selected_count',(SELECT count(*) FROM selected),
 'membership_sha256',(SELECT encode(sha256(convert_to(COALESCE(
 string_agg(pointer||chr(9)||ordinal::text||chr(9)||COALESCE(parent_pointer,'')||chr(10),''
 ORDER BY ordinal),'') ,'UTF8')),'hex') FROM selected))
 UNION ALL
 SELECT 0,ARRAY[a.ordinal,-1]::bigint[],jsonb_build_object('event','record_start',
 'pointer',a.pointer,'record_id',n.record_id,'ordinal',a.ordinal,'parent_pointer',a.parent_pointer,
 'section_pointer',a.section_pointer,'label',a.label,'role','selected')
 FROM selected a JOIN nodes n ON n.native_address=a.pointer
 UNION ALL
 SELECT 0,path,jsonb_build_object('event','native_fragment','native',
 jsonb_build_object('kind',kind,'value',value,'prefix',prefix)) FROM events
 UNION ALL
 SELECT 0,ARRAY[ordinal,3]::bigint[],jsonb_build_object('event','record_end','pointer',pointer)
 FROM selected
 UNION ALL
 SELECT 1,ARRAY[ordinal]::bigint[],jsonb_build_object('event','context','kind','ancestor',
 'pointer',pointer,'ordinal',ordinal,'parent_pointer',parent_pointer,'label',label,
 'name',native_json->'name') FROM access WHERE pointer IN (SELECT pointer FROM ancestors)
 UNION ALL
 SELECT 2,ARRAY[row_number() OVER(ORDER BY r.pointer,r.region_index)]::bigint[],
 jsonb_build_object('event','context','kind','frame','body',to_jsonb(r)-'product_id'-'revision_id')
 FROM kb.pdf_record_region r JOIN published p
 ON r.product_id=p.build_id AND r.revision_id=p.build_id
 WHERE r.pointer IN (SELECT pointer FROM selected)
 UNION ALL
 SELECT 3,ARRAY[position,0]::bigint[],jsonb_build_object('event',
 CASE WHEN family='native_metadata' THEN 'companion_native_start' ELSE 'companion_start' END,
 'family',family,'local_id',local_id,'ordinal',ordinal) FROM companion_order
 UNION ALL
 SELECT 3,ARRAY[c.position,1,part]::bigint[],jsonb_build_object('event','scalar_part',
 'part',part,'encoding','base64','value',encode(substring(convert_to(c.payload,'UTF8')
 FROM (part*32768+1)::integer FOR 32768),'base64'),'final',
 (part+1)*32768>=octet_length(c.payload)) FROM companion_order c
 CROSS JOIN LATERAL generate_series(0,(octet_length(c.payload)-1)/32768) part
 WHERE c.family<>'native_metadata'
 UNION ALL
 SELECT 3,ARRAY[position,2]::bigint[],jsonb_build_object('event','companion_end',
 'byte_length',octet_length(payload),'sha256',encode(sha256(convert_to(payload,'UTF8')),'hex'))
 FROM companion_order WHERE family<>'native_metadata'
 UNION ALL
 SELECT 3,ARRAY[c.position,1,row_number() OVER(PARTITION BY c.position
 ORDER BY e.phase,e.field_name COLLATE "C",e.subphase,e.part_ordinal)]::bigint[],
 jsonb_build_object('event','companion_native_fragment','fragment',e.event)
 FROM metadata_events e JOIN companion_order c ON c.family='native_metadata'
 AND c.local_id=e.local_id
 UNION ALL
 SELECT 3,ARRAY[position,2]::bigint[],jsonb_build_object('event','companion_native_end')
 FROM companion_order WHERE family='native_metadata'
 UNION ALL
 SELECT 4,ARRAY[row_number() OVER(ORDER BY body::text)]::bigint[],
 jsonb_build_object('event','outside_reference','body',body) FROM external
 ) SELECT event FROM output ORDER BY phase,path;
END
catalog.result: SETOF jsonb

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION ops.read_pdf_selected_source_events(
 p_project text,p_run bigint,p_release text,p_task bigint,p_product text,p_digest text,
 p_section text,p_membership text,p_policy text)
RETURNS SETOF jsonb LANGUAGE plpgsql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path=pg_catalog,pg_temp AS $selected$
DECLARE revision ops.pdf_published_revision;
BEGIN
 IF p_section IS NULL OR p_membership IS DISTINCT FROM 'descendants'
 OR p_policy IS DISTINCT FROM 'section-source-context-v1' THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid selected source selector/policy' USING ERRCODE='22023'; END IF;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT revision FROM ops.require_published_companion_pin(
 p_project,p_run,p_release,p_task,p_product,p_digest);
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM kb.pdf_record_access a WHERE a.product_id=revision.build_id
 AND a.revision_id=revision.build_id AND a.pointer=p_section
 AND a.label IN ('section','chapter')) THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'selected source root is not a published section' USING ERRCODE='22023'; END IF;
 RETURN QUERY
WITH RECURSIVE published AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT * FROM ops.read_pdf_published_revision(p_task,p_product,p_digest)
), access AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT a.* FROM kb.pdf_record_access a JOIN published p
 ON a.product_id=p.build_id AND a.revision_id=p.build_id
 ), subtree(pointer) AS (
 SELECT pointer FROM access WHERE pointer=p_section
 UNION ALL SELECT child.pointer FROM access child JOIN subtree parent
 ON child.parent_pointer=parent.pointer
 ), selected AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT * FROM access WHERE pointer IN (SELECT pointer FROM subtree)
 ), ancestors(pointer) AS (
 SELECT parent_pointer FROM access WHERE pointer=p_section AND parent_pointer IS NOT NULL
 UNION SELECT a.parent_pointer FROM access a JOIN ancestors p ON a.pointer=p.pointer
 WHERE a.parent_pointer IS NOT NULL
 ), contained(record_id) AS (
 SELECT n.record_id FROM kb.pdf_record_native n JOIN published p
 ON n.product_id=p.build_id AND n.revision_id=p.build_id
 JOIN selected a ON a.pointer=n.native_address
 UNION
 SELECT child.record_id FROM contained parent JOIN kb.pdf_record_native n
 ON n.record_id=parent.record_id JOIN published p
 ON n.product_id=p.build_id AND n.revision_id=p.build_id
 CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
 SELECT f.value->>'target' AS record_id FROM jsonb_each(n.structure_json->'fields') f
 WHERE f.value->>'kind'='object'
 UNION ALL
 SELECT m.record_id FROM kb.pdf_record_membership m
 WHERE m.product_id=p.build_id AND m.revision_id=p.build_id
 AND m.parent_id=n.record_id AND m.value_kind='record'
 ) child
 ), selected_metadata AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT c.* FROM kb.pdf_record_companion c JOIN published p
 ON c.product_id=p.build_id AND c.revision_id=p.build_id
 WHERE c.family='native_metadata' AND CASE c.body->>'kind'
 WHEN 'formula_outcomes' THEN c.body->>'pointer' IN (SELECT pointer FROM selected)
 WHEN 'recognition_coverage' THEN
 (ops.pdf_companion_body(c.product_id,c.revision_id,c.family,c.local_id,c.body)
 ->'value'->>'section_pointer') IN
 (SELECT pointer FROM selected UNION SELECT pointer FROM ancestors)
 ELSE false END
 ), nodes AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT n.* FROM kb.pdf_record_native n JOIN published p ON n.product_id=p.build_id AND n.revision_id=p.build_id AND (n.record_id IN (SELECT record_id FROM contained))
), members AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT m.* FROM kb.pdf_record_membership m JOIN published p ON m.product_id=p.build_id AND m.revision_id=p.build_id AND m.parent_id IN (SELECT record_id FROM nodes)
), fields AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT record_id,name,value,kind,row_number() OVER(PARTITION BY record_id ORDER BY name COLLATE "C")-1 AS slot
 FROM (
 SELECT n.record_id,x.key AS name,x.value,'scalar'::text AS kind FROM nodes n
 CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each(n.scalars_json) x
 UNION ALL
 SELECT n.record_id,x.key,x.value,x.value->>'kind' FROM nodes n
 CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each(n.structure_json->'fields') x
 ) f
), edges AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT f.record_id AS parent_id,f.value->>'target' AS child_id,ARRAY[1,f.slot,1]::bigint[] AS suffix
 FROM fields f WHERE f.kind='object'
 UNION ALL
 SELECT m.parent_id,m.record_id,ARRAY[1,f.slot,1,1,m.ordinal,1]::bigint[] FROM members m
 JOIN fields f ON f.record_id=m.parent_id AND f.name=m.field_name WHERE m.value_kind='record'
), walk(record_id,path) AS (
 SELECT n.record_id,ARRAY[a.ordinal]::bigint[]
 FROM selected a JOIN nodes n ON n.native_address=a.pointer
 UNION ALL
 SELECT e.child_id,w.path||e.suffix FROM walk w JOIN edges e ON e.parent_id=w.record_id
), events(path,kind,value,prefix) AS (
 SELECT w.path||ARRAY[0]::bigint[],'literal',to_jsonb(CASE WHEN n.native_type='NativeArray' THEN '' ELSE '{' END),''
 FROM walk w JOIN nodes n USING(record_id)
 UNION ALL
 SELECT w.path||ARRAY[1,f.slot,0]::bigint[],'literal',to_jsonb(CASE WHEN n.native_type='NativeArray' THEN ''
 ELSE (CASE WHEN f.slot>0 THEN ',' ELSE '' END)||to_jsonb(f.name)::text||':' END),''
 FROM walk w JOIN nodes n USING(record_id) JOIN fields f USING(record_id)
 UNION ALL
 SELECT w.path||ARRAY[1,f.slot,1]::bigint[],CASE WHEN f.kind='scalar' THEN 'inline' ELSE 'parts' END,
 CASE WHEN f.kind='scalar' THEN f.value ELSE to_jsonb(f.value->>'stream_id') END,''
 FROM walk w JOIN fields f USING(record_id) WHERE f.kind IN ('scalar','parts')
 UNION ALL
 SELECT w.path||ARRAY[1,f.slot,1,0]::bigint[],'literal',to_jsonb(CASE WHEN f.kind='map' THEN '{' ELSE '[' END),''
 FROM walk w JOIN fields f USING(record_id) WHERE f.kind IN ('array','map')
 UNION ALL
 SELECT w.path||ARRAY[1,f.slot,1,1,m.ordinal,0]::bigint[],
 CASE WHEN f.kind='map' AND m.member_key IS NULL THEN 'key_parts' ELSE 'literal' END,
 CASE WHEN f.kind='map' AND m.member_key IS NULL THEN to_jsonb(m.member_key_stream_id)
 ELSE to_jsonb((CASE WHEN m.ordinal>0 THEN ',' ELSE '' END)||
 CASE WHEN f.kind='map' THEN to_jsonb(m.member_key)::text||':' ELSE '' END) END,
 CASE WHEN m.ordinal>0 THEN ',' ELSE '' END
 FROM walk w JOIN fields f USING(record_id) JOIN members m ON m.parent_id=f.record_id AND m.field_name=f.name
 WHERE f.kind IN ('array','map')
 UNION ALL
 SELECT w.path||ARRAY[1,f.slot,1,1,m.ordinal,1]::bigint[],
 CASE WHEN m.value_kind='scalar' THEN 'inline' ELSE 'parts' END,
 CASE WHEN m.value_kind='scalar' THEN m.scalar_json ELSE to_jsonb(m.stream_id) END,''
 FROM walk w JOIN fields f USING(record_id) JOIN members m ON m.parent_id=f.record_id AND m.field_name=f.name
 WHERE m.value_kind IN ('scalar','parts')
 UNION ALL
 SELECT w.path||ARRAY[1,f.slot,1,2]::bigint[],'literal',to_jsonb(CASE WHEN f.kind='map' THEN '}' ELSE ']' END),''
 FROM walk w JOIN fields f USING(record_id) WHERE f.kind IN ('array','map')
 UNION ALL
 SELECT w.path||ARRAY[1,(SELECT count(*) FROM fields f WHERE f.record_id=n.record_id),0]::bigint[],
 'extension',n.structure_json->'extensions'->'stream_id',
 CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT FROM fields f WHERE f.record_id=n.record_id) THEN ',' ELSE '' END
 FROM walk w JOIN nodes n USING(record_id) WHERE n.structure_json ? 'extensions'
 UNION ALL
 SELECT w.path||ARRAY[2]::bigint[],'literal',to_jsonb(CASE WHEN n.native_type='NativeArray' THEN '' ELSE '}' END),''
 FROM walk w JOIN nodes n USING(record_id)
),metadata_companions AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT * FROM selected_metadata
), metadata_fields AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT cf.*,c.ordinal AS row_ordinal FROM kb.pdf_record_companion_field cf
 JOIN metadata_companions c USING(product_id,revision_id,family,local_id)
), metadata_events(ordinal,local_id,phase,field_name,subphase,part_ordinal,event) AS (
 SELECT c.ordinal,c.local_id,0,''::text,0,0::bigint,jsonb_build_object('kind','row','body',c.body) FROM metadata_companions c
 UNION ALL
 SELECT f.row_ordinal,f.local_id,1,f.field_name,0,0::bigint,jsonb_build_object('kind','field','field',
 to_jsonb(s)||jsonb_build_object('field_name',f.field_name,'scalar_kind',f.scalar_kind))
 FROM metadata_fields f JOIN ops.pdf_artifact_stream s USING(product_id,revision_id,stream_id)
 UNION ALL
 SELECT f.row_ordinal,f.local_id,1,f.field_name,1,part.ordinal,jsonb_build_object('kind','part','part',to_jsonb(part))
 FROM metadata_fields f JOIN ops.pdf_artifact_part part USING(product_id,revision_id,stream_id)
 UNION ALL
 SELECT c.ordinal,c.local_id,2,''::text,0,0::bigint,jsonb_build_object('kind','close') FROM metadata_companions c
),
 companion AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT c.family,c.local_id,c.ordinal,c.body::text AS payload
 FROM ops.pdf_record_context_rows(p_task,p_product,p_digest,
 ARRAY(SELECT pointer FROM selected),p_section) c
 UNION ALL SELECT c.family,c.local_id,c.ordinal,
 c.body::text
 FROM kb.pdf_record_companion c JOIN published p
 ON c.product_id=p.build_id AND c.revision_id=p.build_id
 WHERE c.family='health'
 UNION ALL SELECT c.family,c.local_id,c.ordinal,c.body::text FROM selected_metadata c
 UNION ALL SELECT 'endpoint',e.relation_id||':'||e.ordinal::text,e.ordinal,
 jsonb_build_object('relation_id',e.relation_id,'endpoint_ordinal',e.ordinal,'role',e.role,
 'target_task_id',CASE WHEN e.target_task_id=0 THEN p_task ELSE e.target_task_id END,
 'target_product_key',CASE WHEN e.target_task_id=0 THEN p_product ELSE e.target_product_key END,
 'target_content_digest',CASE WHEN e.target_task_id=0
 THEN p_digest ELSE e.target_content_digest END,
 'occurrence_id',e.occurrence_id)::text
 FROM kb.pdf_record_endpoint e JOIN published p
 ON e.product_id=p.build_id AND e.revision_id=p.build_id
 WHERE e.relation_id IN (SELECT c.local_id FROM ops.pdf_record_context_rows(
 p_task,p_product,p_digest,ARRAY(SELECT pointer FROM selected),p_section) c
 WHERE c.family='relation')
 ), companion_order AS (
 SELECT *,row_number() OVER(ORDER BY family COLLATE "C",ordinal,local_id COLLATE "C") AS position
 FROM companion
 ), external AS (
 SELECT jsonb_build_object('from_pointer',a.pointer,'field',r.field_name,
 'reference_id',r.reference_id,'source_id',r.source_id,'native_address',origin.native_address,
 'source_ordinal',a.ordinal,'source_order',to_jsonb(w.path),
 'target',jsonb_build_object('task_id',p_task,'product_key',p_product,'content_digest',p_digest)||
 CASE WHEN r.field_name IN ('source_cell_id','target_cell_id')
 THEN jsonb_build_object('address_space','native_graph_cell','cell_id_lexical',r.native_pointer)
 ELSE jsonb_build_object('address_space','native_item','pointer',r.native_pointer) END,
 'resolution','qualified_external') AS body
 FROM selected a JOIN walk w ON w.path[1]=a.ordinal
 JOIN kb.pdf_record_reference r ON r.source_id=w.record_id
 JOIN nodes origin ON origin.record_id=r.source_id
 JOIN published p ON r.product_id=p.build_id AND r.revision_id=p.build_id
 WHERE r.native_pointer IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM nodes target
 WHERE target.record_id=r.target_id)
 UNION ALL
 SELECT jsonb_build_object('relation_id',e.relation_id,'endpoint_ordinal',e.ordinal,
 'role',e.role,'target',jsonb_build_object('task_id',CASE WHEN e.target_task_id=0
 THEN p_task ELSE e.target_task_id END,
 'product_key',CASE WHEN e.target_task_id=0 THEN p_product ELSE e.target_product_key END,
 'content_digest',CASE WHEN e.target_task_id=0 THEN p_digest ELSE e.target_content_digest END,
 'occurrence_id',e.occurrence_id),'resolution','qualified_external')
 FROM kb.pdf_record_endpoint e JOIN published p
 ON e.product_id=p.build_id AND e.revision_id=p.build_id
 WHERE e.relation_id IN (SELECT local_id FROM companion WHERE family='relation')
 AND NOT ((e.target_task_id,e.target_product_key,e.target_content_digest) IN
 ((p_task,p_product,p_digest),(0::bigint,'@self','@self'))
 AND e.occurrence_id IN (SELECT local_id FROM companion WHERE family='occurrence'))
 ), output(phase,path,event) AS (
 SELECT -1,ARRAY[]::bigint[],jsonb_build_object('event','selection_metadata',
 'selected_count',(SELECT count(*) FROM selected),
 'membership_sha256',(SELECT encode(sha256(convert_to(COALESCE(
 string_agg(pointer||chr(9)||ordinal::text||chr(9)||COALESCE(parent_pointer,'')||chr(10),''
 ORDER BY ordinal),'') ,'UTF8')),'hex') FROM selected))
 UNION ALL
 SELECT 0,ARRAY[a.ordinal,-1]::bigint[],jsonb_build_object('event','record_start',
 'pointer',a.pointer,'record_id',n.record_id,'ordinal',a.ordinal,'parent_pointer',a.parent_pointer,
 'section_pointer',a.section_pointer,'label',a.label,'role','selected')
 FROM selected a JOIN nodes n ON n.native_address=a.pointer
 UNION ALL
 SELECT 0,path,jsonb_build_object('event','native_fragment','native',
 jsonb_build_object('kind',kind,'value',value,'prefix',prefix)) FROM events
 UNION ALL
 SELECT 0,ARRAY[ordinal,3]::bigint[],jsonb_build_object('event','record_end','pointer',pointer)
 FROM selected
 UNION ALL
 SELECT 1,ARRAY[ordinal]::bigint[],jsonb_build_object('event','context','kind','ancestor',
 'pointer',pointer,'ordinal',ordinal,'parent_pointer',parent_pointer,'label',label,
 'name',native_json->'name') FROM access WHERE pointer IN (SELECT pointer FROM ancestors)
 UNION ALL
 SELECT 2,ARRAY[row_number() OVER(ORDER BY r.pointer,r.region_index)]::bigint[],
 jsonb_build_object('event','context','kind','frame','body',to_jsonb(r)-'product_id'-'revision_id')
 FROM kb.pdf_record_region r JOIN published p
 ON r.product_id=p.build_id AND r.revision_id=p.build_id
 WHERE r.pointer IN (SELECT pointer FROM selected)
 UNION ALL
 SELECT 3,ARRAY[position,0]::bigint[],jsonb_build_object('event',
 CASE WHEN family='native_metadata' THEN 'companion_native_start' ELSE 'companion_start' END,
 'family',family,'local_id',local_id,'ordinal',ordinal) FROM companion_order
 UNION ALL
 SELECT 3,ARRAY[c.position,1,part]::bigint[],jsonb_build_object('event','scalar_part',
 'part',part,'encoding','base64','value',encode(substring(convert_to(c.payload,'UTF8')
 FROM (part*32768+1)::integer FOR 32768),'base64'),'final',
 (part+1)*32768>=octet_length(c.payload)) FROM companion_order c
 CROSS JOIN LATERAL generate_series(0,(octet_length(c.payload)-1)/32768) part
 WHERE c.family<>'native_metadata'
 UNION ALL
 SELECT 3,ARRAY[position,2]::bigint[],jsonb_build_object('event','companion_end',
 'byte_length',octet_length(payload),'sha256',encode(sha256(convert_to(payload,'UTF8')),'hex'))
 FROM companion_order WHERE family<>'native_metadata'
 UNION ALL
 SELECT 3,ARRAY[c.position,1,row_number() OVER(PARTITION BY c.position
 ORDER BY e.phase,e.field_name COLLATE "C",e.subphase,e.part_ordinal)]::bigint[],
 jsonb_build_object('event','companion_native_fragment','fragment',e.event)
 FROM metadata_events e JOIN companion_order c ON c.family='native_metadata'
 AND c.local_id=e.local_id
 UNION ALL
 SELECT 3,ARRAY[position,2]::bigint[],jsonb_build_object('event','companion_native_end')
 FROM companion_order WHERE family='native_metadata'
 UNION ALL
 SELECT 4,ARRAY[row_number() OVER(ORDER BY body::text)]::bigint[],
 jsonb_build_object('event','outside_reference','body',body) FROM external
 ) SELECT event FROM output ORDER BY phase,path;
END $selected$

ALTER FUNCTION data.execution_contract_descriptor() OWNER TO corpus_sem_publisher
REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION data.execution_contract_descriptor() FROM PUBLIC
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION data.execution_contract_descriptor() TO corpus_sem_admitter

catalog.arguments: r text
catalog.body:
DECLARE expected jsonb; spec jsonb; model jsonb; owner_name text; invalid_inference boolean;
BEGIN
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM sem.release_finalization WHERE release_id=r) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'release is not finalized' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 PERFORM sem.require_execution_projection(r);
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM sem.release WHERE release_id=r) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'unknown execution release' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 expected:=data.execution_contract_descriptor();
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM sem.physical_contract WHERE physical_id=expected->>'physical_id' AND source_digest=expected->>'physical_checks_source_digest') THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'physical CHECK contract is unavailable' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 SELECT item.value INTO spec FROM sem.physical_contract artifact CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(artifact.checks) item
 LEFT JOIN pg_constraint c ON c.conrelid=to_regclass(item.value->>'relation') AND c.conname=item.value->>'name' AND c.contype='c'
 WHERE artifact.physical_id=expected->>'physical_id' AND (c.oid IS NULL OR NOT c.convalidated OR pg_get_expr(c.conbin,c.conrelid) IS DISTINCT FROM item.value->>'expression') LIMIT 1;
 IF FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'physical CHECK expression differs: %.%',spec->>'relation',spec->>'name' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM pg_constraint c JOIN pg_class rel ON rel.oid=c.conrelid JOIN pg_namespace ns ON ns.oid=rel.relnamespace
 WHERE c.contype='c' AND (expected->'physical_relations') ? (ns.nspname||'.'||rel.relname)
 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM sem.physical_contract artifact CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(artifact.checks) item
 WHERE artifact.physical_id=expected->>'physical_id' AND item.value->>'relation'=ns.nspname||'.'||rel.relname AND item.value->>'name'=c.conname)) THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'unexpected physical CHECK' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 SELECT item.value INTO spec FROM jsonb_array_elements(expected->'views') item
 WHERE to_regclass(item.value->>'relation') IS NULL
 OR regexp_replace(regexp_replace(pg_get_viewdef(to_regclass(item.value->>'relation'),true),'\mAS\M','','gi'),'[[:space:]();]','','g')
 IS DISTINCT FROM regexp_replace(regexp_replace(item.value->>'query','\mAS\M','','gi'),'[[:space:]();]','','g') LIMIT 1;
 IF FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'native selected-fact view differs' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM sem.release archived CROSS JOIN LATERAL
   jsonb_array_elements(convert_from(archived.prepared_bytes,'UTF8')::jsonb->'products'->'diagnostics') diagnostic
   WHERE archived.release_id=r AND (diagnostic->>'outcome' IN ('unsupported','unresolved')
    OR (diagnostic->>'outcome'='unchecked' AND NOT
      (diagnostic->>'code'='unchecked_term' AND diagnostic->>'message'='not4curation:unchecked')))) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'release contains unresolved or unchecked required semantics' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM sem.input i LEFT JOIN sem.sql_admission a
   ON a.release_id=i.release_id AND a.input_kind=i.input_kind AND a.input_name=i.input_name
      AND a.physical_id=expected->>'physical_id'
   WHERE i.release_id=r AND i.input_kind='dependency' AND starts_with(i.input_name,'authored-sql/')
    AND (right(i.input_name,4)<>'.sql' OR length(i.input_name)<=length('authored-sql/.sql')
      OR encode(sha256(i.content),'hex') IS DISTINCT FROM i.content_digest
      OR a.release_id IS NULL OR encode(sha256(a.content),'hex') IS DISTINCT FROM a.content_digest
      OR convert_from(a.content,'UTF8')::jsonb->>'sql' IS DISTINCT FROM convert_from(i.content,'UTF8')
      OR convert_from(a.content,'UTF8')::jsonb->>'release_id' IS DISTINCT FROM r
      OR convert_from(a.content,'UTF8')::jsonb->>'physical_id' IS DISTINCT FROM expected->>'physical_id')) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'required authored SQL lacks exact current physical admission' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM sem.property_applicability pa WHERE pa.release_id=r AND
    (pa.constraint_scope NOT IN ('shape','accepted_value') OR pa.constraints->>'pattern' IS NOT NULL
     OR COALESCE(pa.constraints->'patterns','[]'::jsonb) NOT IN ('[]'::jsonb,'null'::jsonb))) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'unsupported required native constraint scope or pattern' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM sem.release WHERE release_id=r AND profile='semantic-2') THEN RETURN; END IF;
 WITH rules AS (
  SELECT convert_from(body,'UTF8')::jsonb rule FROM sem.registry_row WHERE release_id=r AND kind='inference_rule'
 ), signatures AS (
  SELECT rule->>'kind' kind,rule->>'predicate' predicate,COALESCE(NULLIF(rule->>'target',''),rule->>'predicate') target FROM rules
 ), invalid AS (
  SELECT 1 FROM signatures s WHERE s.kind IS NULL OR s.predicate IS NULL OR s.target IS NULL OR s.kind NOT IN ('inverse','symmetric','transitive','subproperty')
   OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM sem.property_applicability a WHERE a.release_id=r AND a.property_id=s.predicate)
   OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM sem.property_applicability a WHERE a.release_id=r AND a.property_id=s.target)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 1 FROM signatures s JOIN sem.property_applicability a ON a.release_id=r AND a.property_id=s.predicate
  LEFT JOIN sem.class_definition source_range ON source_range.release_id=r AND source_range.name=a.range_name
  LEFT JOIN sem.property_applicability target ON target.release_id=r AND target.property_id=s.target
   AND target.class_id=CASE WHEN s.kind='subproperty' THEN a.class_id ELSE source_range.class_id END
  LEFT JOIN sem.class_definition target_range ON target_range.release_id=r AND target_range.name=target.range_name
  WHERE COALESCE((a.constraints->>'inlined')::boolean,false) OR source_range.class_id IS NULL
   OR target.property_id IS NULL OR COALESCE((target.constraints->>'inlined')::boolean,false) OR target_range.class_id IS NULL
   OR NOT (target_range.class_id=CASE WHEN s.kind IN ('subproperty','transitive') THEN source_range.class_id ELSE a.class_id END
    OR EXISTS(SELECT FROM sem.class_hierarchy h WHERE h.release_id=r AND h.ancestor_id=target_range.class_id
      AND h.class_id=CASE WHEN s.kind IN ('subproperty','transitive') THEN source_range.class_id ELSE a.class_id END))
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 1 FROM sem.property_applicability a CROSS JOIN (VALUES('symmetric'),('transitive')) flags(name)
   WHERE a.release_id=r AND COALESCE((a.constraints->>flags.name)::boolean,false)
    AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM signatures s WHERE s.kind=flags.name AND s.predicate=a.property_id AND s.target=a.property_id)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 1 FROM sem.property_applicability a LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT count(DISTINCT t.property_id) AS count,min(t.property_id) AS target FROM sem.property_applicability t
    WHERE t.release_id=r AND (t.property_id=a.constraints->>'inverse' OR t.constraints->>'name'=a.constraints->>'inverse')
  ) inverse_target ON true
  WHERE a.release_id=r AND NULLIF(a.constraints->>'inverse','') IS NOT NULL
   AND (inverse_target.count<>1 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM signatures s WHERE s.kind='inverse' AND s.predicate=a.property_id AND s.target=inverse_target.target))
 ) SELECT EXISTS(SELECT FROM invalid) INTO invalid_inference;
 IF invalid_inference THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'unsupported required native binary inference profile' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 SELECT pg_get_userbyid(nspowner) INTO owner_name FROM pg_namespace WHERE nspname='sem';
 SELECT convert_from(body,'UTF8')::jsonb INTO model FROM sem.registry_row
 WHERE release_id=r AND kind='execution_model';
 IF model IS NULL OR model->'inputs'->>'compiler_version' IS DISTINCT FROM expected->>'execution_abi' THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'incompatible archived execution ABI' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM sem.execution_operation WHERE release_id=r) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'release execution projection is unavailable' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM sem.artifact WHERE release_id=r AND artifact_name='operation/scientific-policy.json') THEN
  PERFORM sem.require_scientific_layout(r);
 END IF;
 FOR spec IN SELECT jsonb_build_object('id',operation_id) FROM sem.execution_operation WHERE release_id=r LOOP
  PERFORM sem.require_execution_operation(r,spec->>'id');
 END LOOP;
 SELECT item.value INTO spec FROM jsonb_array_elements(expected->'functions') item
 LEFT JOIN pg_proc p ON p.oid=to_regprocedure(item.value->>'signature')
 LEFT JOIN pg_language l ON l.oid=p.prolang
 WHERE p.oid IS NULL OR CASE WHEN item.value ? 'body_profile' THEN
 item.value->>'body_profile' IS DISTINCT FROM 'postgresql-18-sql-standard-v1'
 OR item.value->>'body_kind' IS DISTINCT FROM 'sql_standard'
 OR item.value->>'server_major' IS DISTINCT FROM '18'
 OR (current_setting('server_version_num')::integer/10000)<>(18)
 OR p.prosqlbody IS NULL
 OR encode(sha256(convert_to(pg_get_functiondef(p.oid),'UTF8')),'hex')
 IS DISTINCT FROM item.value->>'body_sha256'
 OR (SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
 'kind',d.deptype,'type',i.type,'schema',i.schema,'name',i.name,'identity',i.identity)
 ORDER BY d.deptype::text COLLATE "C",i.type COLLATE "C",i.schema COLLATE "C",
 i.name COLLATE "C",i.identity COLLATE "C"),'[]'::jsonb)
 FROM pg_depend d CROSS JOIN LATERAL
 pg_identify_object(d.refclassid,d.refobjid,d.refobjsubid) i
 WHERE d.classid='pg_proc'::regclass AND d.objid=p.oid) IS DISTINCT FROM item.value->'dependencies'
 ELSE p.prosqlbody IS NOT NULL OR
 encode(sha256(convert_to(p.prosrc,'UTF8')),'hex')
 IS DISTINCT FROM item.value->>'body_sha256' END
 OR p.prosecdef IS DISTINCT FROM (item.value->>'security')::boolean
 OR p.proisstrict IS DISTINCT FROM (item.value->>'strict')::boolean OR p.provolatile::text IS DISTINCT FROM item.value->>'volatility' OR p.proparallel::text IS DISTINCT FROM item.value->>'parallel' OR p.proleakproof IS DISTINCT FROM (item.value->>'leakproof')::boolean
 OR l.lanname IS DISTINCT FROM item.value->>'language'
 OR p.prorettype IS DISTINCT FROM to_regtype(item.value->>'result')
 OR p.proretset IS DISTINCT FROM (item.value->>'setof')::boolean
 OR (item.value ? 'result_definition' AND pg_get_function_result(p.oid) IS DISTINCT FROM item.value->>'result_definition')
 OR (item.value ? 'argument_definition' AND pg_get_function_arguments(p.oid) IS DISTINCT FROM item.value->>'argument_definition')
 OR (item.value ? 'argument_defaults' AND pg_get_expr(p.proargdefaults,0) IS DISTINCT FROM item.value->>'argument_defaults')
 OR (item.value ? 'cost' AND p.procost IS DISTINCT FROM (item.value->>'cost')::real)
 OR (item.value ? 'rows' AND p.prorows IS DISTINCT FROM (item.value->>'rows')::real)
 OR (item.value ? 'support' AND p.prosupport::regproc::text IS DISTINCT FROM item.value->>'support')
 OR (item.value ? 'catalog_acl' AND COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(
 CASE WHEN a.grantee=0 THEN 'PUBLIC' ELSE pg_get_userbyid(a.grantee) END,a.privilege_type,a.is_grantable)
 ORDER BY CASE WHEN a.grantee=0 THEN 'PUBLIC' ELSE pg_get_userbyid(a.grantee) END,a.privilege_type,a.is_grantable)
 FROM aclexplode(COALESCE(p.proacl,acldefault('f',p.proowner))) a),'[]'::jsonb) IS DISTINCT FROM
 COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(grantee,privilege,grantable) ORDER BY grantee,privilege,grantable)
 FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN entry->>0='$migration_owner' THEN owner_name::text ELSE entry->>0 END AS grantee,
 entry->>1 AS privilege,bool_or((entry->>2)::boolean) AS grantable
 FROM jsonb_array_elements(item.value->'catalog_acl') entry GROUP BY 1,2) bound_acl),'[]'::jsonb))
 OR (CASE WHEN item.value ? 'result_definition' THEN COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(v ORDER BY v) FROM unnest(p.proconfig) v),'[]'::jsonb) ELSE COALESCE(to_jsonb(p.proconfig),'[]'::jsonb) END) IS DISTINCT FROM item.value->'config'
 OR pg_get_userbyid(p.proowner) IS DISTINCT FROM (CASE WHEN item.value->>'owner'='$migration_owner' THEN owner_name ELSE item.value->>'owner' END)
 OR has_function_privilege('corpus_sem_admitter',p.oid,'EXECUTE') IS DISTINCT FROM ((item.value->'execute_roles') ? 'corpus_sem_admitter') OR has_function_privilege('corpus_sem_evaluator',p.oid,'EXECUTE') IS DISTINCT FROM ((item.value->'execute_roles') ? 'corpus_sem_evaluator') OR has_function_privilege('corpus_sem_writer',p.oid,'EXECUTE') IS DISTINCT FROM ((item.value->'execute_roles') ? 'corpus_sem_writer') OR has_function_privilege('corpus_sem_reader',p.oid,'EXECUTE') IS DISTINCT FROM ((item.value->'execute_roles') ? 'corpus_sem_reader') OR EXISTS(SELECT FROM aclexplode(COALESCE(p.proacl,acldefault('f',p.proowner))) a WHERE a.grantee=0 AND a.privilege_type='EXECUTE')
 ORDER BY item.value->>'signature' LIMIT 1;
 IF FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'native execution kernel differs: %',spec->>'signature' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 SELECT item.value INTO spec FROM jsonb_array_elements(expected->'triggers') item
 LEFT JOIN pg_trigger t ON t.tgrelid=to_regclass(item.value->>'relation') AND t.tgname=item.value->>'name' AND NOT t.tgisinternal
 WHERE t.oid IS NULL OR t.tgenabled NOT IN ('O','A') OR t.tgfoid IS DISTINCT FROM to_regprocedure(item.value->>'function') OR t.tgtype<>(item.value->>'type')::integer OR t.tgdeferrable IS DISTINCT FROM (item.value->>'deferrable')::boolean OR t.tginitdeferred IS DISTINCT FROM (item.value->>'deferred')::boolean OR to_jsonb(ARRAY(SELECT a.attname::text FROM unnest(t.tgattr::smallint[]) WITH ORDINALITY attrs(num,position) JOIN pg_attribute a ON a.attrelid=t.tgrelid AND a.attnum=attrs.num ORDER BY attrs.position)) IS DISTINCT FROM item.value->'columns' OR pg_get_expr(t.tgqual,t.tgrelid) IS DISTINCT FROM item.value->>'when' OR encode(t.tgargs,'hex') IS DISTINCT FROM item.value->>'args' LIMIT 1;
 IF FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'native execution guard differs: %.%',spec->>'relation',spec->>'name' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 SELECT item.value INTO spec FROM jsonb_array_elements(expected->'tables') item
 LEFT JOIN pg_class relation ON relation.oid=to_regclass(item.value->>'relation')
 WHERE relation.oid IS NULL OR relation.relkind<>'r' OR relation.relpersistence<>'p'
 OR relation.relrowsecurity OR relation.relforcerowsecurity
 OR pg_get_userbyid(relation.relowner) IS DISTINCT FROM item.value->>'owner'
 OR (SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',a.attname,'type',format_type(a.atttypid,a.atttypmod),'not_null',a.attnotnull,'identity',a.attidentity::text,'generated',a.attgenerated::text,'default',pg_get_expr(default_value.adbin,default_value.adrelid)) ORDER BY a.attnum)
     FROM pg_attribute a LEFT JOIN pg_attrdef default_value ON default_value.adrelid=a.attrelid AND default_value.adnum=a.attnum
     WHERE a.attrelid=relation.oid AND a.attnum>0 AND NOT a.attisdropped) IS DISTINCT FROM item.value->'columns'
 OR (SELECT to_jsonb(ARRAY(SELECT a.attname::text FROM unnest(c.conkey) WITH ORDINALITY cols(num,position) JOIN pg_attribute a ON a.attrelid=c.conrelid AND a.attnum=cols.num ORDER BY cols.position)) FROM pg_constraint c WHERE c.conrelid=relation.oid AND c.contype='p') IS DISTINCT FROM item.value->'primary_key'
 OR (SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',c.conname,'columns',ARRAY(SELECT a.attname::text FROM unnest(c.conkey) WITH ORDINALITY cols(num,position) JOIN pg_attribute a ON a.attrelid=c.conrelid AND a.attnum=cols.num ORDER BY cols.position),'target',remote_schema.nspname||'.'||remote.relname,'remote_columns',ARRAY(SELECT a.attname::text FROM unnest(c.confkey) WITH ORDINALITY cols(num,position) JOIN pg_attribute a ON a.attrelid=c.confrelid AND a.attnum=cols.num ORDER BY cols.position),'on_update',c.confupdtype::text,'on_delete',c.confdeltype::text,'match',c.confmatchtype::text,'deferrable',c.condeferrable,'deferred',c.condeferred,'validated',c.convalidated) ORDER BY c.conname),'[]'::jsonb)
     FROM pg_constraint c JOIN pg_class remote ON remote.oid=c.confrelid JOIN pg_namespace remote_schema ON remote_schema.oid=remote.relnamespace WHERE c.conrelid=relation.oid AND c.contype='f') IS DISTINCT FROM item.value->'foreign_keys'
 OR EXISTS(SELECT FROM (VALUES('corpus_sem_writer'),('corpus_sem_reader'),('corpus_sem_evaluator'),('corpus_sem_admitter')) actors(name) WHERE has_table_privilege(actors.name,relation.oid,'SELECT') IS DISTINCT FROM (COALESCE(item.value->'read_roles','["corpus_sem_writer","corpus_sem_reader","corpus_sem_admitter","corpus_sem_evaluator"]'::jsonb) ? actors.name) OR has_any_column_privilege(actors.name,relation.oid,'SELECT') IS DISTINCT FROM (COALESCE(item.value->'read_roles','["corpus_sem_writer","corpus_sem_reader","corpus_sem_admitter","corpus_sem_evaluator"]'::jsonb) ? actors.name) OR has_table_privilege(actors.name,relation.oid,'INSERT,UPDATE,DELETE,TRUNCATE,REFERENCES,TRIGGER') OR has_any_column_privilege(actors.name,relation.oid,'INSERT,UPDATE,REFERENCES'))
 OR EXISTS(SELECT FROM aclexplode(coalesce(relation.relacl,acldefault('r',relation.relowner))) acl WHERE acl.grantee=0)
 LIMIT 1;
 IF FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'native source frame projection differs: %',spec->>'relation' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 SELECT item.value INTO spec FROM jsonb_array_elements(expected->'readers') item
 CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements_text(item.value->'roles') required_role(name)
 WHERE to_regclass(item.value->>'relation') IS NULL OR NOT has_table_privilege(required_role.name,to_regclass(item.value->>'relation'),'SELECT') LIMIT 1;
 IF FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'required native read capability is unavailable: %',spec->>'relation' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 SELECT item.value INTO spec FROM jsonb_array_elements(expected->'indexes') item
 LEFT JOIN pg_index i ON i.indexrelid=to_regclass(item.value->>'index')
 WHERE i.indexrelid IS NULL OR NOT i.indisvalid OR NOT i.indisready
 OR i.indrelid IS DISTINCT FROM to_regclass(item.value->>'relation')
 OR pg_get_indexdef(i.indexrelid) IS DISTINCT FROM item.value->>'definition' LIMIT 1;
 IF FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'native source search index differs' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname='corpus_sem_evaluator' AND (rolsuper OR rolcreatedb OR rolcreaterole OR rolreplication OR rolbypassrls))
 OR EXISTS(SELECT FROM pg_auth_members m JOIN pg_roles r ON r.oid=m.member WHERE r.rolname='corpus_sem_evaluator') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'unrestricted evaluation principal' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM (VALUES('sem'),('data'),('ops'),('kb'),('eval')) schemas(name) WHERE has_schema_privilege('corpus_sem_evaluator',schemas.name,'CREATE')) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'evaluator schema mutation privilege' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname IN ('sem','data','ops','kb','eval') AND c.relkind IN ('r','p') AND (has_table_privilege('corpus_sem_evaluator',c.oid,'INSERT,UPDATE,DELETE,TRUNCATE,TRIGGER') OR has_any_column_privilege('corpus_sem_evaluator',c.oid,'INSERT,UPDATE'))) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'evaluator direct write privilege' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM (VALUES('corpus_sem_writer'),('corpus_sem_reader')) roles(name) WHERE has_schema_privilege(roles.name,'eval','USAGE,CREATE'))
 OR EXISTS(SELECT FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace CROSS JOIN (VALUES('corpus_sem_writer'),('corpus_sem_reader')) roles(name) WHERE n.nspname='eval' AND c.relkind IN ('r','p') AND (has_table_privilege(roles.name,c.oid,'SELECT,INSERT,UPDATE,DELETE,TRUNCATE,TRIGGER') OR has_any_column_privilege(roles.name,c.oid,'SELECT,INSERT,UPDATE'))) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'reference data leaked to source principal' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname IN ('corpus_sem_writer','corpus_sem_reader') AND (rolsuper OR rolcreaterole OR rolbypassrls)) OR pg_has_role('corpus_sem_writer','corpus_sem_publisher','MEMBER') OR pg_has_role('corpus_sem_reader','corpus_sem_publisher','MEMBER') OR pg_has_role('corpus_sem_writer',owner_name,'MEMBER') OR pg_has_role('corpus_sem_reader',owner_name,'MEMBER') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'unrestricted application principal' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM (VALUES('corpus_sem_writer'),('corpus_sem_reader')) roles(name) CROSS JOIN (VALUES('sem'),('data'),('ops'),('kb')) schemas(name) WHERE has_schema_privilege(roles.name,schemas.name,'CREATE')) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'application schema mutation privilege' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace CROSS JOIN (VALUES('corpus_sem_writer'),('corpus_sem_reader')) roles(name) WHERE n.nspname IN ('sem','data') AND c.relkind IN ('r','p') AND (has_table_privilege(roles.name,c.oid,'INSERT,UPDATE,DELETE,TRUNCATE,TRIGGER') OR has_any_column_privilege(roles.name,c.oid,'INSERT,UPDATE'))) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'application direct semantic write privilege' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM (VALUES('corpus_sem_writer'),('corpus_sem_reader')) roles(name) CROSS JOIN (VALUES('data.publish_contract_batch(text,text,text,bytea)'),('data.validate_state(text,text)'),('data.publish_pre_execution_analysis_batch(text,text,text,bytea,bigint)'),('data.finish_pre_contract_evaluation(bigint,text,text)')) kernels(signature) WHERE has_function_privilege(roles.name,kernels.signature,'EXECUTE')) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'application private kernel privilege' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 SELECT item.value INTO spec FROM jsonb_array_elements(expected->'checks') item
 LEFT JOIN pg_constraint c ON c.conrelid=to_regclass(item.value->>'relation') AND c.conname=item.value->>'name'
 WHERE c.oid IS NULL OR NOT c.convalidated OR pg_get_constraintdef(c.oid) IS DISTINCT FROM item.value->>'definition' LIMIT 1;
 IF FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'native CHECK expression differs: %',spec->>'relation' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname='eval' AND c.relkind IN ('r','p') AND has_table_privilege('corpus_sem_admitter',c.oid,'SELECT,INSERT,UPDATE,DELETE,TRUNCATE')) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'admission principal has reference access' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM (VALUES('corpus_sem_writer'),('corpus_sem_reader'),('corpus_sem_admitter'),('corpus_sem_evaluator')) principal(name)
  WHERE has_database_privilege(principal.name,current_database(),'TEMP') OR pg_has_role(principal.name,'corpus_sem_publisher','MEMBER') OR pg_has_role(principal.name,owner_name,'MEMBER')) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'privileged runtime principal' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM sem.deployment_admission WHERE release_id=r AND physical_id=expected->>'physical_id' AND deployment_id=encode(sha256(convert_to(expected::text,'UTF8')),'hex') AND kind='native' AND content=convert_to(expected::text,'UTF8')) THEN
 IF NOT (pg_has_role(session_user,'corpus_sem_admitter','USAGE') OR pg_has_role(session_user,owner_name,'MEMBER')) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'native admission requires restricted admission phase' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 PERFORM sem.record_deployment_admission(r,expected->>'physical_id',encode(sha256(convert_to(expected::text,'UTF8')),'hex'),'native',convert_to(expected::text,'UTF8'));
 END IF;
END

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION data.require_execution_release(r text) RETURNS void LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path=pg_catalog,pg_temp AS $admission$
DECLARE expected jsonb; spec jsonb; model jsonb; owner_name text; invalid_inference boolean;
BEGIN
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM sem.release_finalization WHERE release_id=r) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'release is not finalized' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 PERFORM sem.require_execution_projection(r);
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM sem.release WHERE release_id=r) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'unknown execution release' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 expected:=data.execution_contract_descriptor();
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM sem.physical_contract WHERE physical_id=expected->>'physical_id' AND source_digest=expected->>'physical_checks_source_digest') THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'physical CHECK contract is unavailable' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 SELECT item.value INTO spec FROM sem.physical_contract artifact CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(artifact.checks) item
 LEFT JOIN pg_constraint c ON c.conrelid=to_regclass(item.value->>'relation') AND c.conname=item.value->>'name' AND c.contype='c'
 WHERE artifact.physical_id=expected->>'physical_id' AND (c.oid IS NULL OR NOT c.convalidated OR pg_get_expr(c.conbin,c.conrelid) IS DISTINCT FROM item.value->>'expression') LIMIT 1;
 IF FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'physical CHECK expression differs: %.%',spec->>'relation',spec->>'name' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM pg_constraint c JOIN pg_class rel ON rel.oid=c.conrelid JOIN pg_namespace ns ON ns.oid=rel.relnamespace
 WHERE c.contype='c' AND (expected->'physical_relations') ? (ns.nspname||'.'||rel.relname)
 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM sem.physical_contract artifact CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(artifact.checks) item
 WHERE artifact.physical_id=expected->>'physical_id' AND item.value->>'relation'=ns.nspname||'.'||rel.relname AND item.value->>'name'=c.conname)) THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'unexpected physical CHECK' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 SELECT item.value INTO spec FROM jsonb_array_elements(expected->'views') item
 WHERE to_regclass(item.value->>'relation') IS NULL
 OR regexp_replace(regexp_replace(pg_get_viewdef(to_regclass(item.value->>'relation'),true),'\mAS\M','','gi'),'[[:space:]();]','','g')
 IS DISTINCT FROM regexp_replace(regexp_replace(item.value->>'query','\mAS\M','','gi'),'[[:space:]();]','','g') LIMIT 1;
 IF FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'native selected-fact view differs' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM sem.release archived CROSS JOIN LATERAL
   jsonb_array_elements(convert_from(archived.prepared_bytes,'UTF8')::jsonb->'products'->'diagnostics') diagnostic
   WHERE archived.release_id=r AND (diagnostic->>'outcome' IN ('unsupported','unresolved')
    OR (diagnostic->>'outcome'='unchecked' AND NOT
      (diagnostic->>'code'='unchecked_term' AND diagnostic->>'message'='not4curation:unchecked')))) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'release contains unresolved or unchecked required semantics' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM sem.input i LEFT JOIN sem.sql_admission a
   ON a.release_id=i.release_id AND a.input_kind=i.input_kind AND a.input_name=i.input_name
      AND a.physical_id=expected->>'physical_id'
   WHERE i.release_id=r AND i.input_kind='dependency' AND starts_with(i.input_name,'authored-sql/')
    AND (right(i.input_name,4)<>'.sql' OR length(i.input_name)<=length('authored-sql/.sql')
      OR encode(sha256(i.content),'hex') IS DISTINCT FROM i.content_digest
      OR a.release_id IS NULL OR encode(sha256(a.content),'hex') IS DISTINCT FROM a.content_digest
      OR convert_from(a.content,'UTF8')::jsonb->>'sql' IS DISTINCT FROM convert_from(i.content,'UTF8')
      OR convert_from(a.content,'UTF8')::jsonb->>'release_id' IS DISTINCT FROM r
      OR convert_from(a.content,'UTF8')::jsonb->>'physical_id' IS DISTINCT FROM expected->>'physical_id')) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'required authored SQL lacks exact current physical admission' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM sem.property_applicability pa WHERE pa.release_id=r AND
    (pa.constraint_scope NOT IN ('shape','accepted_value') OR pa.constraints->>'pattern' IS NOT NULL
     OR COALESCE(pa.constraints->'patterns','[]'::jsonb) NOT IN ('[]'::jsonb,'null'::jsonb))) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'unsupported required native constraint scope or pattern' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM sem.release WHERE release_id=r AND profile='semantic-2') THEN RETURN; END IF;
 WITH rules AS (
  SELECT convert_from(body,'UTF8')::jsonb rule FROM sem.registry_row WHERE release_id=r AND kind='inference_rule'
 ), signatures AS (
  SELECT rule->>'kind' kind,rule->>'predicate' predicate,COALESCE(NULLIF(rule->>'target',''),rule->>'predicate') target FROM rules
 ), invalid AS (
  SELECT 1 FROM signatures s WHERE s.kind IS NULL OR s.predicate IS NULL OR s.target IS NULL OR s.kind NOT IN ('inverse','symmetric','transitive','subproperty')
   OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM sem.property_applicability a WHERE a.release_id=r AND a.property_id=s.predicate)
   OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM sem.property_applicability a WHERE a.release_id=r AND a.property_id=s.target)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 1 FROM signatures s JOIN sem.property_applicability a ON a.release_id=r AND a.property_id=s.predicate
  LEFT JOIN sem.class_definition source_range ON source_range.release_id=r AND source_range.name=a.range_name
  LEFT JOIN sem.property_applicability target ON target.release_id=r AND target.property_id=s.target
   AND target.class_id=CASE WHEN s.kind='subproperty' THEN a.class_id ELSE source_range.class_id END
  LEFT JOIN sem.class_definition target_range ON target_range.release_id=r AND target_range.name=target.range_name
  WHERE COALESCE((a.constraints->>'inlined')::boolean,false) OR source_range.class_id IS NULL
   OR target.property_id IS NULL OR COALESCE((target.constraints->>'inlined')::boolean,false) OR target_range.class_id IS NULL
   OR NOT (target_range.class_id=CASE WHEN s.kind IN ('subproperty','transitive') THEN source_range.class_id ELSE a.class_id END
    OR EXISTS(SELECT FROM sem.class_hierarchy h WHERE h.release_id=r AND h.ancestor_id=target_range.class_id
      AND h.class_id=CASE WHEN s.kind IN ('subproperty','transitive') THEN source_range.class_id ELSE a.class_id END))
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 1 FROM sem.property_applicability a CROSS JOIN (VALUES('symmetric'),('transitive')) flags(name)
   WHERE a.release_id=r AND COALESCE((a.constraints->>flags.name)::boolean,false)
    AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM signatures s WHERE s.kind=flags.name AND s.predicate=a.property_id AND s.target=a.property_id)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 1 FROM sem.property_applicability a LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT count(DISTINCT t.property_id) AS count,min(t.property_id) AS target FROM sem.property_applicability t
    WHERE t.release_id=r AND (t.property_id=a.constraints->>'inverse' OR t.constraints->>'name'=a.constraints->>'inverse')
  ) inverse_target ON true
  WHERE a.release_id=r AND NULLIF(a.constraints->>'inverse','') IS NOT NULL
   AND (inverse_target.count<>1 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM signatures s WHERE s.kind='inverse' AND s.predicate=a.property_id AND s.target=inverse_target.target))
 ) SELECT EXISTS(SELECT FROM invalid) INTO invalid_inference;
 IF invalid_inference THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'unsupported required native binary inference profile' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 SELECT pg_get_userbyid(nspowner) INTO owner_name FROM pg_namespace WHERE nspname='sem';
 SELECT convert_from(body,'UTF8')::jsonb INTO model FROM sem.registry_row
 WHERE release_id=r AND kind='execution_model';
 IF model IS NULL OR model->'inputs'->>'compiler_version' IS DISTINCT FROM expected->>'execution_abi' THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'incompatible archived execution ABI' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM sem.execution_operation WHERE release_id=r) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'release execution projection is unavailable' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM sem.artifact WHERE release_id=r AND artifact_name='operation/scientific-policy.json') THEN
  PERFORM sem.require_scientific_layout(r);
 END IF;
 FOR spec IN SELECT jsonb_build_object('id',operation_id) FROM sem.execution_operation WHERE release_id=r LOOP
  PERFORM sem.require_execution_operation(r,spec->>'id');
 END LOOP;
 SELECT item.value INTO spec FROM jsonb_array_elements(expected->'functions') item
 LEFT JOIN pg_proc p ON p.oid=to_regprocedure(item.value->>'signature')
 LEFT JOIN pg_language l ON l.oid=p.prolang
 WHERE p.oid IS NULL OR CASE WHEN item.value ? 'body_profile' THEN
 item.value->>'body_profile' IS DISTINCT FROM 'postgresql-18-sql-standard-v1'
 OR item.value->>'body_kind' IS DISTINCT FROM 'sql_standard'
 OR item.value->>'server_major' IS DISTINCT FROM '18'
 OR (current_setting('server_version_num')::integer/10000)<>(18)
 OR p.prosqlbody IS NULL
 OR encode(sha256(convert_to(pg_get_functiondef(p.oid),'UTF8')),'hex')
 IS DISTINCT FROM item.value->>'body_sha256'
 OR (SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
 'kind',d.deptype,'type',i.type,'schema',i.schema,'name',i.name,'identity',i.identity)
 ORDER BY d.deptype::text COLLATE "C",i.type COLLATE "C",i.schema COLLATE "C",
 i.name COLLATE "C",i.identity COLLATE "C"),'[]'::jsonb)
 FROM pg_depend d CROSS JOIN LATERAL
 pg_identify_object(d.refclassid,d.refobjid,d.refobjsubid) i
 WHERE d.classid='pg_proc'::regclass AND d.objid=p.oid) IS DISTINCT FROM item.value->'dependencies'
 ELSE p.prosqlbody IS NOT NULL OR
 encode(sha256(convert_to(p.prosrc,'UTF8')),'hex')
 IS DISTINCT FROM item.value->>'body_sha256' END
 OR p.prosecdef IS DISTINCT FROM (item.value->>'security')::boolean
 OR p.proisstrict IS DISTINCT FROM (item.value->>'strict')::boolean OR p.provolatile::text IS DISTINCT FROM item.value->>'volatility' OR p.proparallel::text IS DISTINCT FROM item.value->>'parallel' OR p.proleakproof IS DISTINCT FROM (item.value->>'leakproof')::boolean
 OR l.lanname IS DISTINCT FROM item.value->>'language'
 OR p.prorettype IS DISTINCT FROM to_regtype(item.value->>'result')
 OR p.proretset IS DISTINCT FROM (item.value->>'setof')::boolean
 OR (item.value ? 'result_definition' AND pg_get_function_result(p.oid) IS DISTINCT FROM item.value->>'result_definition')
 OR (item.value ? 'argument_definition' AND pg_get_function_arguments(p.oid) IS DISTINCT FROM item.value->>'argument_definition')
 OR (item.value ? 'argument_defaults' AND pg_get_expr(p.proargdefaults,0) IS DISTINCT FROM item.value->>'argument_defaults')
 OR (item.value ? 'cost' AND p.procost IS DISTINCT FROM (item.value->>'cost')::real)
 OR (item.value ? 'rows' AND p.prorows IS DISTINCT FROM (item.value->>'rows')::real)
 OR (item.value ? 'support' AND p.prosupport::regproc::text IS DISTINCT FROM item.value->>'support')
 OR (item.value ? 'catalog_acl' AND COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(
 CASE WHEN a.grantee=0 THEN 'PUBLIC' ELSE pg_get_userbyid(a.grantee) END,a.privilege_type,a.is_grantable)
 ORDER BY CASE WHEN a.grantee=0 THEN 'PUBLIC' ELSE pg_get_userbyid(a.grantee) END,a.privilege_type,a.is_grantable)
 FROM aclexplode(COALESCE(p.proacl,acldefault('f',p.proowner))) a),'[]'::jsonb) IS DISTINCT FROM
 COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(grantee,privilege,grantable) ORDER BY grantee,privilege,grantable)
 FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN entry->>0='$migration_owner' THEN owner_name::text ELSE entry->>0 END AS grantee,
 entry->>1 AS privilege,bool_or((entry->>2)::boolean) AS grantable
 FROM jsonb_array_elements(item.value->'catalog_acl') entry GROUP BY 1,2) bound_acl),'[]'::jsonb))
 OR (CASE WHEN item.value ? 'result_definition' THEN COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(v ORDER BY v) FROM unnest(p.proconfig) v),'[]'::jsonb) ELSE COALESCE(to_jsonb(p.proconfig),'[]'::jsonb) END) IS DISTINCT FROM item.value->'config'
 OR pg_get_userbyid(p.proowner) IS DISTINCT FROM (CASE WHEN item.value->>'owner'='$migration_owner' THEN owner_name ELSE item.value->>'owner' END)
 OR has_function_privilege('corpus_sem_admitter',p.oid,'EXECUTE') IS DISTINCT FROM ((item.value->'execute_roles') ? 'corpus_sem_admitter') OR has_function_privilege('corpus_sem_evaluator',p.oid,'EXECUTE') IS DISTINCT FROM ((item.value->'execute_roles') ? 'corpus_sem_evaluator') OR has_function_privilege('corpus_sem_writer',p.oid,'EXECUTE') IS DISTINCT FROM ((item.value->'execute_roles') ? 'corpus_sem_writer') OR has_function_privilege('corpus_sem_reader',p.oid,'EXECUTE') IS DISTINCT FROM ((item.value->'execute_roles') ? 'corpus_sem_reader') OR EXISTS(SELECT FROM aclexplode(COALESCE(p.proacl,acldefault('f',p.proowner))) a WHERE a.grantee=0 AND a.privilege_type='EXECUTE')
 ORDER BY item.value->>'signature' LIMIT 1;
 IF FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'native execution kernel differs: %',spec->>'signature' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 SELECT item.value INTO spec FROM jsonb_array_elements(expected->'triggers') item
 LEFT JOIN pg_trigger t ON t.tgrelid=to_regclass(item.value->>'relation') AND t.tgname=item.value->>'name' AND NOT t.tgisinternal
 WHERE t.oid IS NULL OR t.tgenabled NOT IN ('O','A') OR t.tgfoid IS DISTINCT FROM to_regprocedure(item.value->>'function') OR t.tgtype<>(item.value->>'type')::integer OR t.tgdeferrable IS DISTINCT FROM (item.value->>'deferrable')::boolean OR t.tginitdeferred IS DISTINCT FROM (item.value->>'deferred')::boolean OR to_jsonb(ARRAY(SELECT a.attname::text FROM unnest(t.tgattr::smallint[]) WITH ORDINALITY attrs(num,position) JOIN pg_attribute a ON a.attrelid=t.tgrelid AND a.attnum=attrs.num ORDER BY attrs.position)) IS DISTINCT FROM item.value->'columns' OR pg_get_expr(t.tgqual,t.tgrelid) IS DISTINCT FROM item.value->>'when' OR encode(t.tgargs,'hex') IS DISTINCT FROM item.value->>'args' LIMIT 1;
 IF FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'native execution guard differs: %.%',spec->>'relation',spec->>'name' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 SELECT item.value INTO spec FROM jsonb_array_elements(expected->'tables') item
 LEFT JOIN pg_class relation ON relation.oid=to_regclass(item.value->>'relation')
 WHERE relation.oid IS NULL OR relation.relkind<>'r' OR relation.relpersistence<>'p'
 OR relation.relrowsecurity OR relation.relforcerowsecurity
 OR pg_get_userbyid(relation.relowner) IS DISTINCT FROM item.value->>'owner'
 OR (SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',a.attname,'type',format_type(a.atttypid,a.atttypmod),'not_null',a.attnotnull,'identity',a.attidentity::text,'generated',a.attgenerated::text,'default',pg_get_expr(default_value.adbin,default_value.adrelid)) ORDER BY a.attnum)
     FROM pg_attribute a LEFT JOIN pg_attrdef default_value ON default_value.adrelid=a.attrelid AND default_value.adnum=a.attnum
     WHERE a.attrelid=relation.oid AND a.attnum>0 AND NOT a.attisdropped) IS DISTINCT FROM item.value->'columns'
 OR (SELECT to_jsonb(ARRAY(SELECT a.attname::text FROM unnest(c.conkey) WITH ORDINALITY cols(num,position) JOIN pg_attribute a ON a.attrelid=c.conrelid AND a.attnum=cols.num ORDER BY cols.position)) FROM pg_constraint c WHERE c.conrelid=relation.oid AND c.contype='p') IS DISTINCT FROM item.value->'primary_key'
 OR (SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',c.conname,'columns',ARRAY(SELECT a.attname::text FROM unnest(c.conkey) WITH ORDINALITY cols(num,position) JOIN pg_attribute a ON a.attrelid=c.conrelid AND a.attnum=cols.num ORDER BY cols.position),'target',remote_schema.nspname||'.'||remote.relname,'remote_columns',ARRAY(SELECT a.attname::text FROM unnest(c.confkey) WITH ORDINALITY cols(num,position) JOIN pg_attribute a ON a.attrelid=c.confrelid AND a.attnum=cols.num ORDER BY cols.position),'on_update',c.confupdtype::text,'on_delete',c.confdeltype::text,'match',c.confmatchtype::text,'deferrable',c.condeferrable,'deferred',c.condeferred,'validated',c.convalidated) ORDER BY c.conname),'[]'::jsonb)
     FROM pg_constraint c JOIN pg_class remote ON remote.oid=c.confrelid JOIN pg_namespace remote_schema ON remote_schema.oid=remote.relnamespace WHERE c.conrelid=relation.oid AND c.contype='f') IS DISTINCT FROM item.value->'foreign_keys'
 OR EXISTS(SELECT FROM (VALUES('corpus_sem_writer'),('corpus_sem_reader'),('corpus_sem_evaluator'),('corpus_sem_admitter')) actors(name) WHERE has_table_privilege(actors.name,relation.oid,'SELECT') IS DISTINCT FROM (COALESCE(item.value->'read_roles','["corpus_sem_writer","corpus_sem_reader","corpus_sem_admitter","corpus_sem_evaluator"]'::jsonb) ? actors.name) OR has_any_column_privilege(actors.name,relation.oid,'SELECT') IS DISTINCT FROM (COALESCE(item.value->'read_roles','["corpus_sem_writer","corpus_sem_reader","corpus_sem_admitter","corpus_sem_evaluator"]'::jsonb) ? actors.name) OR has_table_privilege(actors.name,relation.oid,'INSERT,UPDATE,DELETE,TRUNCATE,REFERENCES,TRIGGER') OR has_any_column_privilege(actors.name,relation.oid,'INSERT,UPDATE,REFERENCES'))
 OR EXISTS(SELECT FROM aclexplode(coalesce(relation.relacl,acldefault('r',relation.relowner))) acl WHERE acl.grantee=0)
 LIMIT 1;
 IF FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'native source frame projection differs: %',spec->>'relation' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 SELECT item.value INTO spec FROM jsonb_array_elements(expected->'readers') item
 CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements_text(item.value->'roles') required_role(name)
 WHERE to_regclass(item.value->>'relation') IS NULL OR NOT has_table_privilege(required_role.name,to_regclass(item.value->>'relation'),'SELECT') LIMIT 1;
 IF FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'required native read capability is unavailable: %',spec->>'relation' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 SELECT item.value INTO spec FROM jsonb_array_elements(expected->'indexes') item
 LEFT JOIN pg_index i ON i.indexrelid=to_regclass(item.value->>'index')
 WHERE i.indexrelid IS NULL OR NOT i.indisvalid OR NOT i.indisready
 OR i.indrelid IS DISTINCT FROM to_regclass(item.value->>'relation')
 OR pg_get_indexdef(i.indexrelid) IS DISTINCT FROM item.value->>'definition' LIMIT 1;
 IF FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'native source search index differs' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname='corpus_sem_evaluator' AND (rolsuper OR rolcreatedb OR rolcreaterole OR rolreplication OR rolbypassrls))
 OR EXISTS(SELECT FROM pg_auth_members m JOIN pg_roles r ON r.oid=m.member WHERE r.rolname='corpus_sem_evaluator') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'unrestricted evaluation principal' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM (VALUES('sem'),('data'),('ops'),('kb'),('eval')) schemas(name) WHERE has_schema_privilege('corpus_sem_evaluator',schemas.name,'CREATE')) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'evaluator schema mutation privilege' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname IN ('sem','data','ops','kb','eval') AND c.relkind IN ('r','p') AND (has_table_privilege('corpus_sem_evaluator',c.oid,'INSERT,UPDATE,DELETE,TRUNCATE,TRIGGER') OR has_any_column_privilege('corpus_sem_evaluator',c.oid,'INSERT,UPDATE'))) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'evaluator direct write privilege' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM (VALUES('corpus_sem_writer'),('corpus_sem_reader')) roles(name) WHERE has_schema_privilege(roles.name,'eval','USAGE,CREATE'))
 OR EXISTS(SELECT FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace CROSS JOIN (VALUES('corpus_sem_writer'),('corpus_sem_reader')) roles(name) WHERE n.nspname='eval' AND c.relkind IN ('r','p') AND (has_table_privilege(roles.name,c.oid,'SELECT,INSERT,UPDATE,DELETE,TRUNCATE,TRIGGER') OR has_any_column_privilege(roles.name,c.oid,'SELECT,INSERT,UPDATE'))) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'reference data leaked to source principal' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname IN ('corpus_sem_writer','corpus_sem_reader') AND (rolsuper OR rolcreaterole OR rolbypassrls)) OR pg_has_role('corpus_sem_writer','corpus_sem_publisher','MEMBER') OR pg_has_role('corpus_sem_reader','corpus_sem_publisher','MEMBER') OR pg_has_role('corpus_sem_writer',owner_name,'MEMBER') OR pg_has_role('corpus_sem_reader',owner_name,'MEMBER') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'unrestricted application principal' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM (VALUES('corpus_sem_writer'),('corpus_sem_reader')) roles(name) CROSS JOIN (VALUES('sem'),('data'),('ops'),('kb')) schemas(name) WHERE has_schema_privilege(roles.name,schemas.name,'CREATE')) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'application schema mutation privilege' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace CROSS JOIN (VALUES('corpus_sem_writer'),('corpus_sem_reader')) roles(name) WHERE n.nspname IN ('sem','data') AND c.relkind IN ('r','p') AND (has_table_privilege(roles.name,c.oid,'INSERT,UPDATE,DELETE,TRUNCATE,TRIGGER') OR has_any_column_privilege(roles.name,c.oid,'INSERT,UPDATE'))) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'application direct semantic write privilege' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM (VALUES('corpus_sem_writer'),('corpus_sem_reader')) roles(name) CROSS JOIN (VALUES('data.publish_contract_batch(text,text,text,bytea)'),('data.validate_state(text,text)'),('data.publish_pre_execution_analysis_batch(text,text,text,bytea,bigint)'),('data.finish_pre_contract_evaluation(bigint,text,text)')) kernels(signature) WHERE has_function_privilege(roles.name,kernels.signature,'EXECUTE')) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'application private kernel privilege' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 SELECT item.value INTO spec FROM jsonb_array_elements(expected->'checks') item
 LEFT JOIN pg_constraint c ON c.conrelid=to_regclass(item.value->>'relation') AND c.conname=item.value->>'name'
 WHERE c.oid IS NULL OR NOT c.convalidated OR pg_get_constraintdef(c.oid) IS DISTINCT FROM item.value->>'definition' LIMIT 1;
 IF FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'native CHECK expression differs: %',spec->>'relation' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname='eval' AND c.relkind IN ('r','p') AND has_table_privilege('corpus_sem_admitter',c.oid,'SELECT,INSERT,UPDATE,DELETE,TRUNCATE')) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'admission principal has reference access' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM (VALUES('corpus_sem_writer'),('corpus_sem_reader'),('corpus_sem_admitter'),('corpus_sem_evaluator')) principal(name)
  WHERE has_database_privilege(principal.name,current_database(),'TEMP') OR pg_has_role(principal.name,'corpus_sem_publisher','MEMBER') OR pg_has_role(principal.name,owner_name,'MEMBER')) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'privileged runtime principal' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM sem.deployment_admission WHERE release_id=r AND physical_id=expected->>'physical_id' AND deployment_id=encode(sha256(convert_to(expected::text,'UTF8')),'hex') AND kind='native' AND content=convert_to(expected::text,'UTF8')) THEN
 IF NOT (pg_has_role(session_user,'corpus_sem_admitter','USAGE') OR pg_has_role(session_user,owner_name,'MEMBER')) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'native admission requires restricted admission phase' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 PERFORM sem.record_deployment_admission(r,expected->>'physical_id',encode(sha256(convert_to(expected::text,'UTF8')),'hex'),'native',convert_to(expected::text,'UTF8'));
 END IF;
END

    native_document_product.parent_digest,

   FROM ops.native_document_product
UNION ALL
 SELECT p.task_id,
    p.product_key,
    p.content_digest,
    p.release_id,
    p.contract_digest,
    (body.descriptor -> 'content_metadata'::text) ->> 'schema_digest'::text AS schema_digest,
    (body.descriptor -> 'content_metadata'::text) ->> 'recipe_digest'::text AS recipe_digest,
    NULL::bigint AS parent_task_id,
    NULL::text AS parent_product_key,
    NULL::text AS parent_digest,
    b.content -> 'document'::text AS native_json,
    (body.descriptor -> 'content_metadata'::text) -> 'health'::text AS health,
    body.payload
   FROM ops.pdf_product p
     JOIN ops.pdf_product_body body USING (task_id, product_key)
     CROSS JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT (convert_from(body.payload, 'UTF8'::name)::json -> 'content'::text)::jsonb AS content) b
  WHERE p.kind = 'integrated'::text
UNION ALL
 SELECT p.task_id,
    p.product_key,
    p.logical_digest AS content_digest,
    p.release_id,
    contract_input.content_digest AS contract_digest,
    p.schema_digest,
    p.recipe_digest,
    NULL::bigint AS parent_task_id,
    NULL::text AS parent_product_key,
    NULL::text AS parent_digest,
    NULL::jsonb AS native_json,
    ( SELECT c.body - ARRAY['source_scope'::text, 'page_start'::text, 'page_end'::text]
           FROM kb.pdf_record_companion c
          WHERE c.product_id = p.build_id AND c.revision_id = p.build_id AND c.family = 'health'::text AND c.body ? 'source_scope'::text
          ORDER BY c.ordinal, c.local_id
         LIMIT 1) AS health,
    NULL::bytea AS payload
   FROM ops.pdf_published_revision p
     JOIN ops.pdf_build_validation v ON v.build_id = p.build_id
     JOIN sem.input contract_input ON contract_input.release_id = p.release_id AND contract_input.input_kind = 'dependency'::text AND contract_input.input_name = 'execution/schema/pdf_products'::text;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION ops.read_published_input_batch_rows(p_project text, p_run bigint, p_selection_release text, p_task bigint, p_product text, p_digest text, p_build text, p_producer_release text)
 RETURNS TABLE(input_ordinal bigint, input_role text, input_task_id bigint, input_product_key text, input_content_digest text, project_id text, run_id bigint, selection_release_id text, producer_release_id text, task_id bigint, product_key text, content_digest text, projection_id text)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
BEGIN ATOMIC
 WITH companions AS MATERIALIZED (
          SELECT raw.product_id,
             raw.revision_id,
             raw.family,
             raw.local_id,
             raw.ordinal,
             ops.pdf_companion_body(raw.product_id, raw.revision_id, raw.family, raw.local_id, raw.body) AS body
            FROM kb.pdf_record_companion raw
           WHERE ((raw.product_id = read_published_input_batch_rows.p_build) AND (raw.revision_id = read_published_input_batch_rows.p_build) AND (raw.family = 'input'::text))
         )
  SELECT c.ordinal AS input_ordinal,
     (c.body ->> 'role'::text) AS input_role,
     ((c.body ->> 'task_id'::text))::bigint AS input_task_id,
     (c.body ->> 'product_key'::text) AS input_product_key,
     (c.body ->> 'content_digest'::text) AS input_content_digest,
     read_published_input_batch_rows.p_project AS project_id,
     read_published_input_batch_rows.p_run AS run_id,
     read_published_input_batch_rows.p_selection_release AS selection_release_id,
     read_published_input_batch_rows.p_producer_release AS producer_release_id,
     read_published_input_batch_rows.p_task AS task_id,
     read_published_input_batch_rows.p_product AS product_key,
     read_published_input_batch_rows.p_digest AS content_digest,
     'pdf-companion-projection-v2:eb6b06280a7834337e9ef69c7db7f7cd9ba30a83547f3c9f79031a56eeb829c8'::text AS projection_id
    FROM companions c
   WHERE (c.family = 'input'::text)
   ORDER BY c.ordinal;
END
